+    runbook: |
+      The disaggregated B300 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`kimik3.1-fp4-b300-dynamo-vllm-agentic-dspark-mooncake-dcp8-disagg`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#5068](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/5068)). Dynamo + vLLM run TP8 + DCP8 prefill and decode workers, one B300 node each. The prefill workers also run the routed experts EP8 on MegaMoE; the decode workers use no expert parallelism and run the low-latency decode backend. KV moves from prefill to decode over NIXL on its LIBFABRIC backend, and all workers share a Mooncake store in host DRAM on its EFA transport. The lane ran the image digest the preset pins, Dynamo built from `229be5cff1156859b0e3e43b598ee800b2f81ccc` (`v1.7.0-kimi-k3.1-pro-dev.1`) and Mooncake `0.3.14`; the preset has been measured only on that combination, on AWS B300 nodes with 16 EFA devices each.
+
+      | Clients | Prefill workers | Decode workers | Nodes | Draft tokens | Decode `--max-num-seqs` | Decode `--gpu-memory-utilization` | Decode capture sizes |
+      |---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
+      | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 7 | 64 | 0.95 | 8 to 64 in steps of 8 |
+      | 20, 48 | 1 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 64 | 0.95 | 5 to 320 in steps of 5 |
+      | 64 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 64 | 0.95 | 5 to 320 in steps of 5 |
+      | 264 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 128 | 0.98 | 20 to 640 in steps of 20 |
+      | 660 | 4 | 5 | 9 | 4 | 128 | 0.98 | 20 to 640 in steps of 20 |
+
+      Each point renders one prefill worker and one decode worker; start the table's number of workers per role with the same commands, one node each.
+
+      **Serving config.**
+      - **Prefill:** TP8 + DCP8 with `--enable-expert-parallel` and `--moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe`, `--max-num-seqs 32`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.97` and `--enforce-eager`. `--max-async-kv-loads-per-step 4` starts up to four Mooncake store loads per engine step, and `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` chunks prompts with more than 4096 new tokens so that one long prompt does not hold back the others. `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=1` turns on the fused GEMM + reduce-scatter. `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_LIMIT` and `DYN_BACKEND_ADMISSION_ENGINE_REQUEST_WAITING_LIMIT` set Dynamo's admission limits for the prefill engine to 1024 requests each.
+      - **Decode:** TP8 + DCP8 without expert parallelism, with `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=0` and `--max-async-kv-loads-per-step 2`. `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'` runs pure decode steps on the fused low-latency path; the Low-latency decode toggle is not offered under PD, so the preset sets the flag in the decode args. `--use-replayssm` makes KDA verification replay the accepted prefix instead of keeping one recurrent state per draft token. The decode `--compilation-config` sets only the capture sizes (multiples of 1 + draft tokens per request) and replaces the PD strategy's `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, so the CUDA graph mode is vLLM's default, as in the lane. From 264 clients, decode admits up to 128 requests at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.98` and captures up to 640 rows.
+      - **Both roles:** FP8 MLA KV cache with an MXFP4 indexer key cache (`indexer_kv_dtype`); FP32 KDA conv and recurrent state (`--mamba-cache-dtype float32 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32`), as the K3.1 precision policy requires; the A2A DCP backend and the direct DCP all-to-all and gather paths (`VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_*`); prefix caching with `--prefix-match-unit 128`; `--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune` and `--stream-interval 10`. Both roles pin `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1`: left unset, NIXL P/D raises the DCP KV interleave after the specialized decode has read it.
+      - **Spec decoding** (on in this preset) uses the K3.1 DSpark draft [`Inferact/Kimi-K3.1-Pro-DSpark-preview`](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3.1-Pro-DSpark-preview) at revision `6a2ef20a`, with probabilistic drafting and block rejection: 7 draft tokens at 1 client, 4 from 20 clients up.
+      - **Collectives and kernels:** FlashInfer all-reduce stays on (`VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER=1`); NCCL symmetric memory and the sharded sequence-parallel shared expert stay off (`VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM=0`, `VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=0`), and so do TOKENSPEED_MLA's FP16 partials (`TOKENSPEED_MLA_FP16_PARTIALS=0`). NCCL runs only inside a node (`NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=0`, `NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1`, `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL`, `NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none`, `NCCL_TUNER_PLUGIN=ofi`).
+      - **KV transfer over EFA:** the NIXL connector uses `"backends": ["LIBFABRIC"]`, with `NIXL_DISABLE_CUDA_ADDR_WA=1`, `FI_EFA_ENABLE_SHM_TRANSFER=0`, `UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE=n` and `UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO=inet`. The Mooncake transfer engine uses `MC_SLICE_SIZE=1048576`, `MC_MAX_MR_SIZE=68719476736`, `MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1`, `MC_EFA_NIC_SELECTION=local` and `MC_MS_FILTERS` set to the node's 16 EFA devices, and `WITH_NVIDIA_PEERMEM=0` for hosts without the nvidia-peermem module. A rank registers tens of GB of GPU KV cache with the store, so `MC_MAX_MR_SIZE` must be above that: at the 4 GiB of the GB300 presets, every registration fails over EFA. vLLM loads from the store with 4 receive threads (`VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=4`), and `VLLM_MOONCAKE_STORE_SELECTIVE_LEASE=1` makes a store lookup lease only the keys that a hit loads. The connector options add a 60 s store lookup timeout, `store_tp_size: 1` and `store_chunk_size: 4096`. From 264 clients, the store keeps the tail pages a request loaded and drops the older tails it consumed (`VLLM_MOONCAKE_STORE_KEEP_LOADED_TAIL=1`, `VLLM_MOONCAKE_STORE_DROP_CONSUMED_TAILS=1`), and store lookups start before admission, up to 16 at a time and kept for 30 s (`lookup_prefetch_limit: 16`, `lookup_prefetch_ttl_s: 30`); this cuts store evictions and the prefill work they cause.
+      - **660 clients:** the indexer computes its logits in BF16 on both roles (`"indexer_logits_dtype":"bfloat16"` in `--attention-config`), prefill selects the indexer top-k with `--kernel-config '{"sparse_indexer_topk_backend":"deep_select"}'`, and the Mooncake master evicts 2% of the store per round instead of 10% (`--eviction_ratio=0.02`, see Services).
+      - **Timeouts and housekeeping:** `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600` (from the recipe's Blackwell settings), `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT=600000`, `DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120` and `ETCD_LEASE_TTL=600`. `TILELANG_CLEANUP_TEMP_FILES=1` removes TileLang's temporary build files.
+
+      **Tool calling and reasoning** are on in this preset. Under Dynamo the builder renders `--dyn-tool-call-parser kimi_k3`, `--dyn-reasoning-parser kimi_k3` and vLLM's `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3`, and the preset adds `--dyn-enable-structural-tag`: the flags of the lane's accuracy runs.
+
+      The preset selects the distributed (embedded) Mooncake store on the **KV Offload** row, which wraps NIXL and the `MooncakeStoreConnector` in one `MultiConnector` on both roles; the preset sets the lane's connector options on it. Documented here only: the worker counts, the lane's Mooncake master options and store sizing (the builder's Mooncake option shows its own defaults), and the frontend's router mode and session affinity (the builder renders round-robin).
+
+      ### Services
+
+      Start etcd, NATS and a Mooncake master once:
+
+      ```bash
+      etcd --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 --advertise-client-urls http://<infra-host>:2379
+      printf 'max_payload: 33554432\n' > nats.conf && nats-server -c nats.conf
+      mooncake_master --default_kv_lease_ttl=60000 --eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 --eviction_ratio=0.10
+      ```
+
+      For 660 clients, start the master with `--eviction_ratio=0.02`.
+
+      Every worker reads the Mooncake store configuration from the JSON file that `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH` points to. The lane registered 190GB of host DRAM per GPU over the EFA transport:
+
+      ```json
+      {"master_server_address": "<infra-host>:<master-port>", "metadata_server": "P2PHANDSHAKE",
+       "global_segment_size": "190GB", "local_buffer_size": "4GB", "protocol": "efa",
+       "mode": "embedded", "enable_offload": false}
+      ```
+
+      ### Frontend
+
+      ```bash
+      export DYN_ROUTER_ACTIVE_REQUEST_EXPIRY_SECS=3600 DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8589934592 DYN_TCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=120
+      export DYN_DISABLE_OPENAI_STRICT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=1
+      python3 -m dynamo.frontend --router-mode least-loaded --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 1
+      ```
+
+      `DYN_DISABLE_OPENAI_STRICT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=1` skips the frontend's preflight validation of tool parameter schemas marked `strict: true`. Session affinity keys on the `X-Dynamo-Session-Id` request header, so send one ID per conversation.
+
+      ### Benchmark-only settings left out
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The Muse Spark specialized decode's attention kernels on FP8 KV caches,
+with the page sizes the hybrid KV cache manager gives them."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="the specialized decode kernels run on SM100-family devices",
+)
+
+# Power-of-two scales keep every dequantized entry exact in BF16, so a
+# quantized cache must reproduce the BF16 kernel on its dequantization bitwise.
+K_SCALE, V_SCALE = 0.5, 2.0
+PATHS = [
+    (1, 2048, [8, 700, 2048], 0),  # one-cluster kernel
+    (2, 16384, [33, 4000], 0),  # split kernel, short path
+    (1, 32768, [100, 9000, 20000], 0),  # split kernel, long path
+    (1, 32768, [3000, 20000], 512),  # sliding window
+]
+
+
+def _attn2(attn2, q, gate, kv, block_table, lens, kv_heads, max_len, window, quant):
+    split = attn2.split_kernel(max_len, window)
+    num_splits = 4 if split and not window else 1
+    workspace = None
+    if split:
+        workspace = torch.zeros(
+            attn2.workspace_bytes(q.shape[0] * attn2.HEADS * kv_heads, num_splits),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+        )
+    out = torch.empty_like(q)
+    attn2.attn2(
+        q,
+        kv,
+        block_table,
+        lens,
+        gate,
+        out,
+        kv_heads,
+        max_seq_len=max_len,
+        window=window,
+        num_splits=num_splits,
+        workspace=workspace,
+        kv_quant=quant,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def _fp8_cache(shape):
+    k = (torch.randn(shape) * 2 / K_SCALE).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    v = (torch.randn(shape) / V_SCALE).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    cache = torch.cat([k.view(torch.uint8), v.view(torch.uint8)], -1)
+    bf16 = torch.cat([k.float() * K_SCALE, v.float() * V_SCALE], -1).bfloat16()
+    return cache.contiguous(), bf16.contiguous()
+
+
+def _case(kv_heads, seq_lens, slots):
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.attention import (
+        attn2,
+    )
+
+    rows, width = 8 * len(seq_lens), kv_heads * attn2.HEADS * attn2.HEAD_DIM
+    q = torch.randn(rows, width).bfloat16()
+    gate = torch.randn(rows, width).bfloat16()
+    pages = -(-max(seq_lens) // slots)
+    num_pages = len(seq_lens) * pages + 3
+    block_table = torch.randperm(num_pages)[: len(seq_lens) * pages]
+    block_table = block_table.int().view(len(seq_lens), pages)
+    lens = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+    shape = (num_pages, kv_heads, slots, attn2.HEAD_DIM)
+    return attn2, q, gate, block_table, lens, shape
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_heads,max_len,seq_lens,window", PATHS)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_attn2_page_size_only_changes_addressing(kv_heads, max_len, seq_lens, window):
+    """A 32-slot BF16 cache gives the 16-slot kernel's result on the same
+    entries: the hybrid KV cache manager's larger pages read as sub-pages."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        attn2, q, gate, bt32, lens, shape = _case(kv_heads, seq_lens, 32)
+        cache32 = torch.randn(*shape[:3], 128).bfloat16()
+        # Page p of 32 slots is pages 2 p and 2 p + 1 of 16.
+        cache16 = cache32.view(shape[0], kv_heads, 2, 16, 128).transpose(1, 2)
+        cache16 = cache16.reshape(2 * shape[0], kv_heads, 16, 128).contiguous()
+        bt16 = torch.stack([2 * bt32, 2 * bt32 + 1], -1).flatten(1)
+        args = (kv_heads, max_len, window, None)
+        out32 = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, cache32, bt32, lens, *args)
+        out16 = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, cache16, bt16, lens, *args)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out32, out16, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [16, 32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_heads,max_len,seq_lens,window", PATHS)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_attn2_fp8_cache_matches_bf16_on_its_dequantization(
+    slots, kv_heads, max_len, seq_lens, window
+):
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.attention import (
+        kv_format,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        attn2, q, gate, block_table, lens, shape = _case(kv_heads, seq_lens, slots)
+        cache, bf16 = _fp8_cache(shape)
+        args = (block_table, lens, kv_heads, max_len, window)
+        ref = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, bf16, *args, None)
+        quant = kv_format.KvQuant("fp8", K_SCALE, V_SCALE)
+        out = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, cache, *args, quant)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, atol=0, rtol=0)
+        # vLLM allocates uint8; a float8_e4m3fn view is the same cache.
+        fp8_view = cache.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        out_view = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, fp8_view, *args, quant)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out_view, ref, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [16, 32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [1, 8, 16])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_qkv_front_fp8_insert_is_the_stock_store(slots, m):
+    """The QKV front stores, for an FP8 cache, what
+    `reshape_and_cache_flash` stores of the k and v its BF16 variant writes;
+    the projection output is the BF16 variant's."""
+    import vllm._custom_ops  # noqa: F401  (registers _C_cache_ops)
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.attention import (
+        kv_format,
+        qkv_front,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    quant = kv_format.KvQuant("fp8", 0.37, 0.05)
+    hq, hkv, head_dim = 16, 2, qkv_front.HEAD_DIM
+    n = (2 * hq + 2 * hkv) * head_dim
+    pages = 4
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        weight = (torch.randn(n, qkv_front.HIDDEN) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+        x = torch.randn(m, qkv_front.HIDDEN).bfloat16()
+        freqs = torch.arange(4096)[:, None] / (
+            10000 ** (torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2) / head_dim)
+        )
+        cos_sin = torch.cat([freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()], -1).contiguous()
+        positions = torch.randint(0, 4096, (m,))
+        slot_mapping = torch.randperm(pages * slots)[:m]
+        if m > 1:
+            slot_mapping[0] = -1  # a padded token: no insert
+        bf16_cache = torch.zeros(pages, hkv, slots, 2 * head_dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        bf16_out = torch.empty(m, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        qkv_front.qkv_front(
+            x, weight, positions, cos_sin, slot_mapping, bf16_cache, bf16_out, 1e-5
+        )
+        cache = torch.zeros(pages, hkv, slots, 2 * head_dim, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        expected = torch.zeros_like(cache)
+        k_cache, v_cache = expected.transpose(1, 2).split(head_dim, dim=-1)
+        out = torch.empty_like(bf16_out)
+        qkv_front.qkv_front(
+            x, weight, positions, cos_sin, slot_mapping, cache, out, 1e-5, quant
+        )
+        # The stock store of the BF16 variant's k and v.
+        valid = slot_mapping >= 0
+        slots_v = slot_mapping[valid]
+        rows = bf16_cache[slots_v // slots, :, slots_v % slots]  # [t, hkv, 128]
+        torch.ops._C_cache_ops.reshape_and_cache_flash(
+            rows[..., :head_dim].contiguous(),
+            rows[..., head_dim:].contiguous(),
+            k_cache,
+            v_cache,
+            slots_v,
+            "fp8",
+            torch.tensor([quant.k_scale]),
+            torch.tensor([quant.v_scale]),
+        )
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, bf16_out, atol=0, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(cache, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+def _padded(cache: torch.Tensor, pad: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """`cache` in pages `pad` elements longer than dense, as the hybrid KV
+    cache manager pads a group's pages to the largest group's page bytes."""
+    pages, page = cache.shape[0], cache[0].numel()
+    storage = torch.full((pages, page + pad), 0x55, dtype=cache.dtype)
+    storage[:, :page] = cache.reshape(pages, page)
+    return storage.as_strided(
+        cache.shape, (page + pad, *cache.stride()[1:]), storage.storage_offset()
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["bf16", "fp8"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_heads,max_len,seq_lens,window", PATHS[1:3])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_attn2_reads_padded_pages(kind, kv_heads, max_len, seq_lens, window):
+    """Padded pages read as dense."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.attention import (
+        kv_format,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        attn2, q, gate, block_table, lens, shape = _case(kv_heads, seq_lens, 16)
+        if kind == "bf16":
+            cache, quant = torch.randn(*shape[:3], 128).bfloat16(), None
+        else:
+            cache = _fp8_cache(shape)[0]
+            quant = kv_format.KvQuant(kind, K_SCALE, V_SCALE)
+        args = (block_table, lens, kv_heads, max_len, window, quant)
+        dense = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, cache, *args)
+        padded = _attn2(attn2, q, gate, _padded(cache, 1024), *args)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(padded, dense, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["bf16", "fp8"])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_qkv_front_writes_padded_pages(kind):
+    """The insert lands in the same rows of padded pages and leaves the
+    padding alone."""
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.attention import (
+        kv_format,
+        qkv_front,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    m, hq, hkv, pages, slots = 8, 16, 2, 4, 16
+    n = (2 * hq + 2 * hkv) * qkv_front.HEAD_DIM
+    quant = None if kind == "bf16" else kv_format.KvQuant(kind, 0.37, 0.05)
+    shape = (pages, hkv, slots, 128)
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if kind == "bf16" else torch.uint8
+    with torch.device("cuda"):
+        weight = (torch.randn(n, qkv_front.HIDDEN) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+        x = torch.randn(m, qkv_front.HIDDEN).bfloat16()
+        positions = torch.arange(m)
+        slot_mapping = torch.randperm(pages * slots)[:m]
+        dense = torch.zeros(shape, dtype=dtype)
+        padded = _padded(torch.zeros(shape, dtype=dtype), 1024)
+        out = torch.empty(m, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        for cache in (dense, padded):
+            qkv_front.qkv_front(
+                x, weight, positions, None, slot_mapping, cache, out, 1e-5, quant
+            )
+        padding = padded.as_strided(
+            (pages, 1024), (padded.stride(0), 1), padded[0].numel()
+        )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(padded.contiguous(), dense, atol=0, rtol=0)
+    assert bool((padding == 0x55).all())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The KV cache formats the QKV front writes and attn2 reads, head_dim 64 and
+P = 16 or 32 slots a page (the hybrid KV cache manager gives an FP8 group
+32-slot pages when other layers keep BF16, e.g. with
+--kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers):
+
+- bf16: [pages, H, P, 128] BF16, K | V per slot.
+- fp8: the same in E4M3 bytes (uint8 or float8_e4m3fn storage), entries
+  stored divided by the per-tensor k_scale / v_scale.
+
+The kernels work in 16-slot sub-pages: sub-page i of a request is sub-page
+i % (P / 16) of its block-table entry i // (P / 16).
+"""
+
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+
+HEAD_DIM = 64
+PAGE = 16  # slots of a sub-page
+PAGE_SLOTS = (16, 32)
+KINDS = ("bf16", "fp8")
+FP8_STORAGE = (torch.uint8, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+
+class KvQuant(NamedTuple):
+    """A quantized cache: `kind` "fp8" and the per-tensor scales."""
+
+    kind: str
+    k_scale: float
+    v_scale: float
+
+
+class KvLayout(NamedTuple):
+    """The compile-time cache layout: format and slots a page."""
+
+    kind: str
+    slots: int = PAGE
+
+    @property
+    def shift(self) -> int:
+        """log2 of the sub-pages a page."""
+        return (self.slots // PAGE).bit_length() - 1
+
+
+BF16 = KvLayout("bf16")
+
+
+def elem_bytes(kind: str) -> int:
+    """Bytes per cache element of a BF16 or FP8 cache."""
+    return 1 if kind == "fp8" else 2
+
+
+def kind_of(quant: KvQuant | None) -> str:
+    return "bf16" if quant is None else quant.kind
+
+
+def layout_of(kv_cache: torch.Tensor, kind: str) -> KvLayout:
+    if kv_cache.dim() != 4:
+        return KvLayout(kind, 0)
+    return KvLayout(kind, kv_cache.shape[2])
+
+
+def layout_ok(kv_cache: torch.Tensor, num_kv_heads: int, kind: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether a cache has the layout of `kind` for these KV heads: pages of
+    16 or 32 slots of dense heads (HND), 16-byte aligned. Pages may be
+    padded (the hybrid KV cache manager pads a group's pages to the largest
+    group's bytes)."""
+    if kind == "bf16":
+        dtype_ok = kv_cache.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    elif kind == "fp8":
+        dtype_ok = kv_cache.dtype in FP8_STORAGE
+    else:
+        return False
+    heads, row = num_kv_heads, 2 * HEAD_DIM
+    if not dtype_ok or kv_cache.dim() != 4:
+        return False
+    page = kv_cache.shape[2]
+    if page not in PAGE_SLOTS or tuple(kv_cache.shape[1:]) != (heads, page, row):
+        return False
+    stride = kv_cache.stride()
+    return (
+        stride[0] >= heads * page * row
+        and stride[0] * kv_cache.element_size() % 16 == 0
+        and (heads == 1 or stride[1] == page * row)
+        and stride[2] == row
+        and stride[3] == 1
+        and kv_cache.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("page_size", [16, 32, 64])
+def test_candidate_logits_int32_page_ids(page_size: int):
+    """Preserve physical page IDs across the full supported int32 range."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.candidate_paged_logits import (
+        prepare_candidate_pages,
+    )

+    max_page = torch.iinfo(torch.int32).max - 1

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+        (32, 8, 1, 0, 0, 64),

+def test_candidate_logits_layout_and_graph(
+    page_size: int, block_size: int, next_n: int, pad: int, offset: int, tile: int
+):
+    """Direct paged reads preserve causal bounds, strided rows and graph replay.
+
+    Small integer FP8 operands make every dot product and weighted sum exact,
+    so the independent PyTorch reference needs no numerical tolerance.
+    """
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.sparse_mqa_logits import (
+        candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.candidate_paged_logits import (
+        candidate_paged_logits,
+        prepare_candidate_pages,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    batch, count = 4, 128
+    rows, width = batch * next_n, count * block_size
+    req_lens = torch.tensor([0, 1, 3073, 8197], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    lens = req_lens[:, None] - next_n + torch.arange(1, next_n + 1, device="cuda")
+    lens = lens.clamp(min=0).to(torch.int32).flatten()
+    pages_per_req = (8197 + page_size - 1) // page_size
+    pages = batch * pages_per_req
+    table = torch.randperm(pages, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(batch, -1)
+    row_indices = torch.arange(rows, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32) // next_n
+    key = torch.randint(-4, 5, (pages, page_size, 128), device="cuda").to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    scales = torch.exp2(torch.randint(-4, 1, (pages, page_size), device="cuda").float())
+    page_bytes = page_size * 132
+    backing = torch.empty(
+        pages * (page_bytes + pad) + offset, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"
+    )
+    cache = backing.as_strided(
+        (pages, page_size, 132), (page_bytes + pad, 132, 1), offset
+    )
+    cache.view(pages, page_bytes).copy_(
+        torch.cat((key.view(torch.uint8).flatten(1), scales.view(torch.uint8)), dim=1)
+    )
+    q = torch.randint(-4, 5, (rows, 36, 128), device="cuda").to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)[
+        :, :32
+    ]
+    weights = (torch.randint(-8, 9, (rows, 39), device="cuda").float() / 128)[:, :32]
+    candidates = _make_candidates(lens, count, block_size).cuda()
+    candidates = candidates[:, torch.randperm(count, device="cuda")]
+    starts = torch.zeros_like(lens)
+    si = torch.empty_like(candidates)
+    physical_blocks = torch.empty_like(candidates)
+    end = torch.empty_like(lens)
+    out = torch.empty((rows, width + 64), device="cuda")[:, :width]
+
+    def run():
+        candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices(
+            candidates, starts, lens, block_size, block_size, out=(si, end)
+        )
+        prepare_candidate_pages(
+            table,
+            si,
+            end,
+            row_indices,
+            physical_blocks,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            sparse_block_size=block_size,
+        )
+        candidate_paged_logits(
+            q,
+            cache,
+            weights,
+            si,
+            physical_blocks,
+            end,
+            out,
+            sparse_block_size=block_size,
+            tile_tokens=tile,
+        )
+
+    def reference():
+        idx, valid_end = _expand_candidates_reference(
+            candidates, starts, lens, block_size, block_size
+        )
+        positions = (
+            (idx[:, :, None] * block_size + torch.arange(block_size, device="cuda"))
+            .flatten(1)
+            .long()
+        )
+        page = table[row_indices.long()[:, None], positions // page_size].long()
+        keys = key.float()[page, positions % page_size]
+        scale = scales[page, positions % page_size]
+        dots = torch.einsum("rhd,rcd->rhc", q.float(), keys)
+        expected = (dots.relu() * weights[:, :, None]).sum(1) * scale
+        return expected.masked_fill(
+            torch.arange(width, device="cuda")[None] >= valid_end[:, None], -torch.inf
+        )
+
+    run()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, reference(), atol=0, rtol=0)
+    original_lens, original_candidates = lens.clone(), candidates.clone()
+    lens //= 2
+    candidates[:, ::3] = -1
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        run()
+    out.fill_(float("nan"))
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, reference(), atol=0, rtol=0)
+    # A short capture must also handle more candidates and relocated pages.
+    lens.copy_(original_lens)
+    candidates.copy_(original_candidates)
+    table.copy_(table.roll(1, dims=1))
+    out.fill_(float("nan"))
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, reference(), atol=0, rtol=0)

+    or not torch.cuda.is_available()
+    or not sparse_indexer.current_platform.is_device_capability_family(90),

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("large_page_stride", [False, True])

+class CandidateRowsKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel[int]):
+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(compress_ratio: int) -> Any:
+        @cute.kernel
+        def device_kernel(
+            starts: cute.Tensor,
+            lens: cute.Tensor,
+            row_lens: cute.Tensor,
+            row_indices: cute.Tensor,
+        ):
+            request, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            start, end = starts[request], starts[request + 1]
+            length = lens[request]
+            for row in range(start + tid, end, 32):
+                row_lens[row] = cutlass.max(
+                    (length - (end - row) + 1) // compress_ratio, 0
+                )
+                row_indices[row] = request
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def entry(
+            starts: cute.Tensor,
+            lens: cute.Tensor,
+            row_lens: cute.Tensor,
+            row_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            stream: CUstream,
+        ):
+            device_kernel(starts, lens, row_lens, row_indices).launch(
+                grid=(lens.shape[0], 1, 1), block=(32, 1, 1), stream=stream
+            )
+

+    def kernel(key: tuple[int, int]) -> Any:
+        page_size, sparse_block_size = key

+        @cute.kernel
+        def device_kernel(
+            block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            sparse_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            valid_end: cute.Tensor,
+            row_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            physical_blocks: cute.Tensor,
+        ):
+            tile, row, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            block = tile * 256 + tid
+            if block < sparse_indices.shape[1]:
+                page = Int32(0)
+                if block * sparse_block_size < valid_end[row]:
+                    pos = sparse_indices[row, block] * sparse_block_size
+                    page = block_table[row_indices[row], pos // page_size]
+                physical_blocks[row, block] = page

+        def entry(
+            block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            sparse_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            valid_end: cute.Tensor,
+            row_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            physical_blocks: cute.Tensor,
+            stream: CUstream,

+                    sparse_indices.shape[0],
+                    1,

+                block=(256, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,

+            return make_fake_tensor(

+                (cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int()),
+                (cute.sym_int(), 1),
+                assumed_align=dtype.width // 8,
+            )
+
+        def vector():

+                        if tid % 8 == 0:
+                            scales[token] = scale
+                cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+                cute.arch.cp_async_wait_group(0)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(key.use_tma):
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(loaded, 0)
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+
+                thread_mma = tiled_mma.get_slice(tid)
+                a = tiled_mma.make_fragment_A(tiled_mma.get_slice(0).partition_A(sk))
+                b = tiled_mma.make_fragment_B(tiled_mma.get_slice(0).partition_B(sq))
+                coords = thread_mma.partition_C(
+                    cute.make_identity_tensor((tile_tokens, 32))
+                )
+                acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor(coords.shape, Float32)
+                acc.fill(0)
+                warpgroup.fence()
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(a, mode=[2])):
+                    tiled_mma.set(warpgroup.Field.ACCUMULATE, k != 0)
+                    cute.gemm(tiled_mma, acc, a[None, None, k], b[None, None, k], acc)
+                warpgroup.commit_group()
+                warpgroup.wait_group(0)
+
+                # Match DeepGEMM's FP32 reduction order, including scale placement.
+                # Each group of four lanes owns two token rows and all 32 heads.
+                for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(tile_tokens // 64):
+                    partial = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Float32)
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        i = m * 16 + j
+                        partial[j] = (
+                            cute.arch.fmax(acc[i], Float32(0))
+                            * weights[row, coords[i][1]]
+                        )
+                    for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, 4):
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            i = m * 16 + h * 4 + j
+                            partial[j] += (
+                                cute.arch.fmax(acc[i], Float32(0))
+                                * weights[row, coords[i][1]]
+                            )
+                    token0 = coords[m * 16][0]
+                    token1 = coords[m * 16 + 2][0]
+                    sum0 = (partial[0] + partial[1]) * scales[token0]
+                    sum1 = (partial[2] + partial[3]) * scales[token1]
+                    for delta in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        sum0 += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(sum0, offset=1 << delta)
+                        sum1 += cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(sum1, offset=1 << delta)
+                    if tid % 4 == 0:
+                        value0 = sum0
+                        value1 = sum1
+                        if start + token0 >= end:
+                            value0 = Float32(-float("inf"))
+                        if start + token1 >= end:
+                            value1 = Float32(-float("inf"))
+                        logits[row, start + token0] = value0
+                        logits[row, start + token1] = value1
+            else:
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.ceil_div(tile_tokens, 128)):
+                    if tid + i * 128 < tile_tokens:
+                        logits[row, start + tid + i * 128] = Float32(-float("inf"))
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def entry(
+            q: cute.Tensor,
+            cache: cute.Tensor,
+            weights: cute.Tensor,
+            sparse_indices: cute.Tensor,
+            physical_blocks: cute.Tensor,
+            valid_end: cute.Tensor,
+            logits: cute.Tensor,
+            page_stride: Int64,
+            page_count: Int32,
+            stream: CUstream,
+        ):
+            tiled_mma = cute.make_tiled_mma(
+                warpgroup.MmaF8Op(
+                    Float8E4M3FN,
+                    Float8E4M3FN,
+                    Float32,
+                    (64, 32, 32),
+                    warpgroup.OperandSource.SMEM,
+                    OperandMajorMode.K,
+                    OperandMajorMode.K,
+                )
+            )
+            tma = None
+            if cutlass.const_expr(key.use_tma):
+                # Each page stores all FP8 key bytes before its FP32 scales.
+                paged = cute.make_tensor(
+                    cute.recast_ptr(cache.iterator, dtype=Float8E4M3FN),
+                    cute.make_layout(
+                        (page_size, 128, page_count),
+                        stride=(128, 1, Int32(page_stride * 4)),
+                    ),
+                )
+                tma_layout = cute.make_composed_layout(
+                    cute.make_swizzle(3, 4, 3),
+                    0,
+                    cute.make_layout((sparse_block_size, 128), stride=(128, 1)),
+                )
+                tma = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+                    cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+                    paged,
+                    tma_layout,
+                    (sparse_block_size, 128),
+                )
+            device_kernel(
+                q,
+                cache,
+                weights,
+                sparse_indices,
+                physical_blocks,
+                valid_end,
+                logits,
+                page_stride,
+                tiled_mma,
+                tma,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=(q.shape[0], cute.ceil_div(logits.shape[1], tile_tokens), 1),
+                block=(128, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+        return entry
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(
+        self, *, page_size: int, sparse_block_size: int
+    ) -> list[CompileKey]:
+        return [
+            self.CompileKey(
+                page_size,
+                sparse_block_size,
+                aligned_cache=aligned,
+                use_tma=use_tma,
+                tile_tokens=tile,
+            )
+            for aligned, use_tma, tile in (
+                (False, False, 64),
+                (True, False, 64),
+                (True, True, 64),
+                (True, True, 128),
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, key: CompileKey) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        rows, width = cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int(divisibility=64)
+        return (
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32,
+                (rows, 32, 32),
+                (cute.sym_int(divisibility=4), 32, 1),
+                assumed_align=16,
+            ),
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32,
+                (cute.sym_int64(),),
+                (1,),
+                assumed_align=16 if key.aligned_cache else 4,
+            ),
+            make_fake_tensor(Float32, (rows, 32), (cute.sym_int(), 1), assumed_align=4),
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32, (rows, cute.sym_int()), (cute.sym_int(), 1), assumed_align=4
+            ),
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32, (rows, cute.sym_int()), (cute.sym_int(), 1), assumed_align=4
+            ),
+            make_fake_tensor(Int32, (rows,), (cute.sym_int(),), assumed_align=4),
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Float32, (rows, width), (cute.sym_int(), 1), assumed_align=4
+            ),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        cache: torch.Tensor,
+        weights: torch.Tensor,
+        sparse_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        physical_blocks: torch.Tensor,
+        valid_end: torch.Tensor,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        sparse_block_size: int,
+        tile_tokens: int | None = None,
+    ) -> CuTeDSLLaunchSpec[CompileKey]:
+        page_size = cache.shape[1]
+        assert q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn and q.shape[1:] == (32, 128)
+        assert q.stride(1) == 128 and q.stride(2) == 1
+        assert q.stride(0) % 16 == 0 and q.storage_offset() % 16 == 0
+        assert cache.dtype == torch.uint8 and cache.shape[2] == 132
+        assert cache.stride(1) == 132 and cache.stride(2) == 1
+        assert cache.stride(0) % 4 == 0 and cache.storage_offset() % 4 == 0
+        assert page_size in (16, 32, 64) and sparse_block_size in (8, 16)
+        assert logits.dtype == weights.dtype == torch.float32
+        assert weights.shape == q.shape[:2] and weights.stride(1) == 1
+        assert sparse_indices.dtype == physical_blocks.dtype == torch.int32
+        assert sparse_indices.stride(1) == physical_blocks.stride(1) == 1
+        assert sparse_indices.shape == physical_blocks.shape
+        assert valid_end.dtype == torch.int32 and valid_end.shape == (q.shape[0],)
+        assert logits.shape == (
+            q.shape[0],
+            physical_blocks.shape[1] * sparse_block_size,
+        )
+        assert logits.stride(1) == 1
+        aligned = cache.stride(0) % 16 == 0 and cache.storage_offset() % 16 == 0
+        # The TMA descriptor uses a 32-bit page stride; retain 64-bit cp.async
+        # addressing for unusually wide interleaved-cache layouts.
+        use_tma = aligned and cache.stride(0) < 2**31
+        if tile_tokens is None:
+            # These dimensions stay fixed during CUDA Graph replay.
+            tile_tokens = (
+                128
+                if use_tma and q.shape[0] >= 24 and logits.shape[1] % 128 == 0
+                else 64
+            )
+        assert tile_tokens in (64, 128, 256) and logits.shape[1] % tile_tokens == 0
+        cache_bytes = (cache.shape[0] - 1) * cache.stride(0) + page_size * 132
+        cache_words = cache.as_strided((cache_bytes,), (1,)).view(torch.int32)
+        return (
+            self.CompileKey(
+                page_size,
+                sparse_block_size,
+                aligned_cache=aligned,
+                use_tma=use_tma,
+                tile_tokens=tile_tokens,
+            ),
+            (
+                q.view(torch.int32),
+                cache_words,
+                weights,
+                sparse_indices,
+                physical_blocks,
+                valid_end,
+                logits,
+                cache.stride(0) // 4,
+                cache.shape[0],
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+prepare_candidate_pages = CandidatePagePlanKernel()
+candidate_paged_logits = CandidatePagedLogitsKernel()

+### Short image names
+
+Release images (from v0.33.0) and nightly images are also published under the
+shorter `vllm/vllm` name, with the platform as a tag suffix. These are the same
+images (same digests) as the `vllm/vllm-openai*` tags.
+
+| Image | `vllm/vllm` tag |
+| --- | --- |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai:{latest,v<version>,nightly}` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai:{latest,v<version>}-efa` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>}-efa` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai:cu134-nightly` | `vllm/vllm:nightly-cu134` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}-rocm` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}-<variant>` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}-<variant>`, e.g. `-rocm100` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:{latest,v<version>,nightly}` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}-cpu` |
+| `vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:{latest,v<version>,nightly}` | `vllm/vllm:{latest,v<version>,nightly}-xpu` |
+
+For example, `docker pull vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm` pulls the same image as
+`docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.33.0`. Per-architecture tags, ROCm `-base`
+images and commit-pinned nightly tags (`nightly-<commit>`) are only published
+under the `vllm/vllm-openai*` names.
+
+Release images for ROCm and XPU are also published as `vllm/vllm-rocm` and
+`vllm/vllm-xpu`, with the same tags as `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm` and
+`vllm/vllm-openai-xpu` (e.g. `vllm/vllm-rocm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm-xpu:latest`).
+
 ## Run a vLLM Recipes configuration
 
 [vLLM Recipes](https://recipes.vllm.ai/) can be converted into `config.yaml`

+_BRIDGE_METADATA = (
+    "draft_block_causal_version",
+    "last_write_refine_version",
+    "selected_prefix_bridge.independent_write_version",
+    "selected_prefix_bridge.terminal_disabled_version",
+    "selected_prefix_bridge.out.weight",
+)
+
+
+class AdjacentCausalInjection(nn.Module):
+    """BF16 adjacent injection and FP32 last-write refinement."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        transfer_dim: int,
+        message_dim: int,
+        num_layers: int,
+        block_size: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        eps: float,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.transfer_dim = transfer_dim
+        self.num_layers = num_layers
+        self.block_size = block_size
+        self.eps = eps
+
+        def linear(input_size, output_size, name):
+            return ReplicatedLinear(
+                input_size,
+                output_size,
+                bias=False,
+                params_dtype=params_dtype,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, name),
+                return_bias=False,
+            )
+
+        self.readouts = nn.ModuleList(
+            linear(hidden_size, transfer_dim, f"readouts.{layer_idx}")
+            for layer_idx in range(num_layers)
+        )
+        self.writes = nn.ModuleList(
+            linear(message_dim, hidden_size, f"writes.{layer_idx}")
+            for layer_idx in range(num_layers)
+        )
+        self.message = linear(transfer_dim, message_dim, "message")
+        self.receiver_gate = linear(transfer_dim, message_dim, "receiver_gate")
+        self.predecessor_gate = linear(transfer_dim, message_dim, "predecessor_gate")
+        self.gate_bias = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(message_dim, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def rms(states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return (
+            states.float()
+            .square()
+            .mean(-1, keepdim=True)
+            .clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny)
+            .sqrt()
+        )
+
+    def project(self, layer_idx: int, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        normalized = hidden_states.float() / (self.rms(hidden_states) + self.eps)
+        projected = self.readouts[layer_idx](normalized.to(hidden_states.dtype)).float()
+        features = (
+            math.sqrt(self.transfer_dim)
+            * projected
+            / (projected.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
+        )
+        return features.to(hidden_states.dtype)
+
+    def token_features(
+        self, codebook: torch.Tensor, token_ids: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return (codebook[token_ids.long()].float() * math.sqrt(self.transfer_dim)).to(
+            codebook.dtype
+        )
+
+    def write(
+        self,
+        layer_idx,
+        receiver_states,
+        receiver_features,
+        predecessor_features,
+        *,
+        refine: bool = False,
+    ):
+        def linear(layer, features):
+            if refine:
+                return F.linear(features, layer.weight.float())
+            return layer(features).float()
+
+        gate = torch.sigmoid(
+            self.receiver_gate(receiver_features).float()
+            + linear(self.predecessor_gate, predecessor_features)
+            + self.gate_bias.float()
+        )
+        message = linear(self.message, predecessor_features)
+        gated_message = gate * message
+        if not refine:
+            gated_message = gated_message.to(receiver_states.dtype)
+        update = linear(self.writes[layer_idx], gated_message)
+        result = receiver_states.float() + self.rms(receiver_states) * update
+        return result if refine else result.to(receiver_states.dtype)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        layer_idx: int,
+        pre_injection_states: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        anchor_features: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        blocks = pre_injection_states.reshape(-1, self.block_size, self.hidden_size)
+        features = self.project(layer_idx, blocks)
+        predecessor = torch.cat((anchor_features[:, None, :], features[:, 1:-1]), dim=1)
+        successors = self.write(layer_idx, blocks[:, 1:], features[:, 1:], predecessor)
+        return torch.cat((blocks[:, :1], successors), dim=1).reshape_as(
+            pre_injection_states
+        )
+
+
+def _score_transitions(
+    injection: AdjacentCausalInjection,
+    norm: nn.Module,
+    lm_head: ParallelLMHead,
+    transfer_codebook: torch.Tensor,
+    candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    final_pre_injection: torch.Tensor,
+    anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    final_layer_idx: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    top_k = candidate_ids.shape[-1]
+    predecessor_ids = torch.cat(
+        (
+            anchor_token_ids[:, None, None].expand(-1, 1, top_k),
+            candidate_ids[:, :-1],
+        ),
+        dim=1,
+    )
+    receiver_features = injection.project(final_layer_idx, final_pre_injection)
+    receiver_states = final_pre_injection[:, :, None, :]
+    local_ids = candidate_ids.long()
+    if lm_head.tp_size > 1:
+        shard = lm_head.shard_indices
+        local_ids, nonlocal_mask = get_masked_input_and_mask(
+            local_ids,
+            shard.org_vocab_start_index,
+            shard.org_vocab_end_index,
+            shard.num_org_vocab_padding,
+            shard.added_vocab_start_index,
+            shard.added_vocab_end_index,
+        )
+    successor_weights = lm_head.weight[local_ids].float()
+    exact_features = transfer_codebook[predecessor_ids].float() * math.sqrt(
+        injection.transfer_dim
+    )
+    refined = injection.write(
+        final_layer_idx,
+        receiver_states,
+        receiver_features[:, :, None, :],
+        exact_features,
+        refine=True,
+    )
+    normalized = (
+        refined
+        / (refined.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + norm.variance_epsilon).sqrt()
+        * norm.weight.float()
+    )
+    scores = torch.einsum("bnkh,bnjh->bnkj", normalized, successor_weights)
+    if lm_head.tp_size > 1:
+        scores.masked_fill_(nonlocal_mask.unsqueeze(-2), 0)
+        scores = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(scores)
+    return scores
+

+class DSpineQwen3Model(DFlashQwen3Model):
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = DFlashQwen3Model.hf_to_vllm_mapper | WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_substr={"transfer_embeddings": "transfer_codebook"},
+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        start_layer_id: int = 0,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            start_layer_id=start_layer_id,
+            prefix=prefix,
+        )
+        draft_config = self.config.dflash_config
+        speculative_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        assert speculative_config is not None
+        block_size = 1 + speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens
+        configured_block_size = int(draft_config.get("block_size", block_size))
+        if configured_block_size != block_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DSpine block_size must equal 1 + num_speculative_tokens: "
+                f"{configured_block_size} != {block_size}."
+            )
+        transfer_dim = int(draft_config["transfer_dim"])
+        if transfer_dim > self.config.hidden_size:
+            raise ValueError("DSpine transfer_dim cannot exceed hidden_size.")
+        self.transition_top_k = int(draft_config["transition_top_k"])
+        self.injection = AdjacentCausalInjection(
+            hidden_size=self.config.hidden_size,
+            transfer_dim=transfer_dim,
+            message_dim=int(draft_config["message_dim"]),
+            num_layers=len(self.layers),
+            block_size=block_size,
+            params_dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            eps=float(draft_config.get("transfer_space_eps", 1e-6)),
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "injection"),
+        )
+        self.transfer_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(
+                self.config.vocab_size,
+                transfer_dim,
+                dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+            ),
+            requires_grad=False,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        input_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if input_embeds is None:
+            input_embeds = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        hidden_states = input_embeds
+        residual = None
+        anchor_features = self.injection.token_features(
+            self.transfer_codebook, input_ids[:: self.injection.block_size]
+        )
+        final_pre_injection = hidden_states
+        for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions=positions,
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                residual=residual,
+            )
+            pre_injection = (
+                hidden_states if residual is None else hidden_states + residual
+            )
+            if layer_idx == len(self.layers) - 1:
+                final_pre_injection = pre_injection
+            hidden_states = self.injection(
+                layer_idx, pre_injection, anchor_features=anchor_features
+            )
+            residual = None
+        hidden_states = self.norm(hidden_states)
+        return hidden_states, final_pre_injection
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        weights = list(weights)
+        if not any(name.startswith("selected_prefix_bridge.") for name, _ in weights):
+            return super().load_weights(weights)
+        self._validate_bridge_metadata(dict(weights))
+        mapped = list(self._map_bridge_weights(weights))
+        loaded = super().load_weights(mapped)
+        required = {"transfer_codebook"} | {
+            f"injection.{name}" for name, _ in self.injection.named_parameters()
+        }
+        if missing := required - loaded:
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing DSpine bridge weights: {sorted(missing)}")
+        return loaded
+
+    def _validate_bridge_metadata(self, weights: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+        if missing := set(_BRIDGE_METADATA[2:]) - weights.keys():
+            raise ValueError(f"Missing DSpine bridge metadata: {sorted(missing)}")
+        for name in _BRIDGE_METADATA[:-1]:
+            if name in weights:
+                weight = weights[name]
+                if weight.numel() != 1 or weight.item() != 1:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported DSpine checkpoint version: {name}")
+        terminal = weights["selected_prefix_bridge.out.weight"]
+        if (
+            tuple(terminal.shape)
+            != (self.injection.transfer_dim, self.injection.message.output_size)
+            or terminal.count_nonzero().item()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("DSpine requires a zero terminal projection")
+
+    def _map_bridge_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]):
+        aliases = {
+            "codebook": "transfer_codebook",
+            "read_weight": f"injection.readouts.{self.injection.num_layers - 1}.weight",
+            "gate.weight": "injection.receiver_gate.weight",
+            "gate.bias": "injection.gate_bias",
+            "predecessor_gate.weight": "injection.predecessor_gate.weight",
+            "prev.weight": "injection.message.weight",
+        }
+        for name, weight in weights:
+            if name in _BRIDGE_METADATA:
+                continue
+            key = name.removeprefix("selected_prefix_bridge.")
+            if key in ("early_read_weights", "feature_write_weights"):
+                read = key == "early_read_weights"
+                count = self.injection.num_layers - int(read)
+                if weight.ndim != 3 or weight.shape[0] != count:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid DSpine layer stack: {name}")
+                for index, tensor in enumerate(weight):
+                    module = "readouts" if read else "writes"
+                    yield f"injection.{module}.{index}.weight", tensor
+            else:
+                yield aliases.get(key, name), weight
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+from transformers import PreTrainedConfig
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dflash2.speculator import DFlash2Speculator
+
+
+class DSpineSpeculator(DFlash2Speculator):
+    _speculator_name = "DSpine"
+    _candidate_top_k_key = "transition_top_k"
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, device: torch.device):
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        draft_config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        _maybe_override_dspine_config(draft_config)
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, device)
+
+    def _prepare_candidates(self, model_output, num_reqs):
+        hidden_states, final_pre_injection = model_output
+        num_sample = num_reqs * self.num_speculative_steps
+        sample_indices = self.sample_indices[:num_sample]
+        candidate_ids, _ = self.model.compute_candidates(hidden_states[sample_indices])
+        final_pre_injection = final_pre_injection[sample_indices].view(
+            num_reqs, self.num_speculative_steps, -1
+        )
+        candidate_ids = candidate_ids.view(
+            num_reqs, self.num_speculative_steps, self.top_k
+        )
+        anchor_token_ids = self.input_buffers.input_ids[
+            : num_reqs * self.num_query_per_req : self.num_query_per_req
+        ]
+        scores = self.model.compute_transition_scores(
+            candidate_ids, final_pre_injection, anchor_token_ids
+        )
+        return candidate_ids, scores
+
+
+def _maybe_override_dspine_config(config: PreTrainedConfig) -> None:
+    """Map the original DSpine checkpoint's settings to the `dflash_config`
+    keys that Speculators checkpoints use (see `update_dspine`)."""
+    draft = config.dflash_config
+    bridge = draft.get("selected_prefix_code_bridge")
+    if bridge is None:
+        return
+    expected = {
+        "draft_block_causal": True,
+        "selected_prefix_terminal": False,
+        "selected_prefix_feature_writes": True,
+        "selected_prefix_feature_write_mode": "independent",
+        "selected_prefix_feature_layers": list(range(1, config.num_hidden_layers + 1)),
+    }
+    if (
+        getattr(config, "is_causal", True) is False
+        or any(draft.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items())
+        or draft.get("selected_prefix_feature_next_token_rows", False)
+        or draft.get("selected_prefix_feature_reliability") is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("DSpine requires independent causal writes at every layer.")
+    second = getattr(config, "code_bridge_second_pass", {})
+    refine = draft.get("selected_prefix_last_write_refine", {})
+    if (
+        second.get("mode") != "serial_table"
+        or second.get("first_exact") != config.num_hidden_layers - 1
+        or refine.get("kind") != "exact_sender"
+        or second.get("head_topk") != refine.get("head_topk")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "DSpine requires matching serial last-write refinement settings."
+        )
+    draft.update(
+        block_size=config.block_size,
+        transfer_dim=bridge["code_size"],
+        message_dim=bridge["rank"],
+        transition_top_k=second["head_topk"],
+        transfer_space_eps=bridge["eps"],
+        causal=True,
+        sample_from_anchor=False,
+    )

+class AiterTritonPerTensorFp8ScaledMMLinearKernel(ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel):
+    # Largest batch sent to Triton; larger batches run on hipBLASLt.
+    MAX_M = 256

+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(

+        if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+            return False, "requires ROCm."
+        if current_platform.is_fp8_fnuz():

+        if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_fp8_enabled():
+            return (
+                False,
+                (
+                    "requires setting `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` "
+                    "and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1`. "
+                    "`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR` default is True."
+                ),
+            )
+        try:
+            import aiter  # noqa: F401
+        except Exception:
+            return False, "requires aiter library to be installed."
+        # Batches outside the Triton range run on ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.
+        return ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.is_supported(compute_capability)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(cls, c: FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if c.weight_shape is None:
+            return False, "weight_shape is required for Aiter kernels"
+        N, K = c.weight_shape
+
+        if c.out_dtype is not torch.bfloat16:
+            return False, "requires bfloat16 output dtype."
+
+        can_implement, reason = ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.can_implement(c)
+        if not can_implement:
+            return can_implement, reason
+
+        if not c.activation_quant_key.scale.static:
+            return False, "requires static activation scales."
+
+        # Aiter's Triton Gemm performs better than torch only when it's tuned.
+        if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_triton_gemm_a8w8_tuned(N, K, cls.MAX_M):
+            return (
+                False,
+                (
+                    f"requires a tuned configuration for N: {N} and K: {K} "
+                    f"up to M: {cls.MAX_M}."
+                ),
+            )
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        w, w_s, x_s, _ = self._get_layer_params(layer)
+        assert x_s is not None
+
+        # gemm_a8w8 reads one scale per row of x and per column of w, so the
+        # static per-tensor scales are expanded once here.
+        layer.register_buffer(
+            "aiter_x_scale_vec",
+            x_s.reshape(1).float().expand(self.MAX_M).contiguous(),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        layer.register_buffer(
+            "aiter_w_scale_vec",
+            w_s.reshape(1).float().expand(w.shape[1]).contiguous(),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+
+    def apply_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        w, w_s, x_s, x_s_ub = self._get_layer_params(layer)
+
+        x_2d = x.view(-1, x.shape[-1])
+        x_2d_q, x_s = self.quant_fp8(x_2d, x_s, x_s_ub)
+        output = rocm_aiter_ops.triton_per_tensor_fp8_gemm(
+            x_2d_q,
+            w,
+            self.config.out_dtype,
+            x_s,
+            w_s,
+            bias,
+            layer.aiter_x_scale_vec,
+            layer.aiter_w_scale_vec,
+            self.MAX_M,
+        )
+        return output.view(*x.shape[:-1], w.shape[1])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Cross-node NVLink fabric detection via NVML."""
+
+import ctypes
+import functools
+from enum import Enum, auto
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import in_the_same_node_as
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import import_pynvml
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from torch.distributed import ProcessGroup
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+pynvml = import_pynvml()
+
+_NULL_CLUSTER_UUID = bytes(pynvml.NVML_GPU_FABRIC_UUID_LEN)
+_NvlinkFabricKey = tuple[str, int]
+
+
+class SymmetricMemoryTopology(Enum):
+    INTRA_NODE = auto()
+    CROSS_NODE_NVLINK = auto()
+    UNSUPPORTED = auto()
+
+
+def _local_physical_device_id() -> int:
+    visible_device_id = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    return current_platform.visible_device_id_to_physical_device_id(visible_device_id)
+
+
+def _fabric_uuid_bytes(fabric: ctypes.Structure) -> bytes:
+    offset = type(fabric).clusterUuid.offset
+    return ctypes.string_at(
+        ctypes.addressof(fabric) + offset,
+        pynvml.NVML_GPU_FABRIC_UUID_LEN,
+    )
+
+
+def _get_local_nvlink_fabric_key() -> _NvlinkFabricKey | None:
+    try:
+        pynvml.nvmlInit()
+        try:
+            handle = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(_local_physical_device_id())
+            fabric = pynvml.c_nvmlGpuFabricInfoV_t()
+            pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetGpuFabricInfoV(handle, ctypes.byref(fabric))
+        finally:
+            pynvml.nvmlShutdown()
+    except Exception as error:
+        logger.debug("NVML fabric detection failed: %s", error)
+        return None
+
+    if (
+        fabric.state != pynvml.NVML_GPU_FABRIC_STATE_COMPLETED
+        or fabric.status != pynvml.NVML_SUCCESS
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    cluster_uuid = _fabric_uuid_bytes(fabric)
+    if cluster_uuid == _NULL_CLUSTER_UUID:
+        return None
+    return (cluster_uuid.hex(), int(fabric.cliqueId))
+
+
+def has_cross_node_nvlink(group: "ProcessGroup") -> bool:
+    """Return whether all ranks report the same valid NVLink fabric.
+
+    Detection fails closed when fabric information is unavailable or incomplete.
+    The caller is responsible for establishing that the group crosses nodes.
+    """
+    if (
+        not current_platform.is_cuda()
+        or not dist.is_available()
+        or not dist.is_initialized()
+    ):
+        return False
+
+    world_size = dist.get_world_size(group=group)
+    if world_size <= 1:
+        return False
+
+    fabric_keys: list[_NvlinkFabricKey | None] = [None] * world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(
+        fabric_keys,
+        _get_local_nvlink_fabric_key(),
+        group=group,
+    )
+    valid_keys = [key for key in fabric_keys if key is not None]
+    if len(valid_keys) != world_size:
+        return False
+
+    has_shared_fabric = len(set(valid_keys)) == 1
+    if has_shared_fabric:
+        logger.info_once(
+            "Detected multi-node NVLink fabric: %s",
+            valid_keys[0],
+            scope="local",
+        )
+    return has_shared_fabric
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def get_symmetric_memory_topology(
+    group: "ProcessGroup",
+) -> SymmetricMemoryTopology:
+    """Classify whether a CPU process group can safely rendezvous.
+
+    Same-node symmetric-memory rendezvous can reject unsupported GPU
+    connectivity synchronously. Cross-node rendezvous is safe to attempt only
+    when every rank reports the same healthy NVLink fabric.
+    """
+    if all(in_the_same_node_as(group, source_rank=0)):
+        return SymmetricMemoryTopology.INTRA_NODE
+    if has_cross_node_nvlink(group):
+        return SymmetricMemoryTopology.CROSS_NODE_NVLINK
+    return SymmetricMemoryTopology.UNSUPPORTED

+def _check_k3_replay_and_threshold(worker, grids, hits, misses):
+    """Run one image batch through the real manager; compare with eager.
+
+    Args:
+        grids: grid_thw of each image in the batch.
+        hits: expected graph hits for the batch.
+        misses: expected eager fallbacks for the batch.
+
+    """
+    import torch
+
+    from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed
+
+    runner = worker.model_runner
+    manager = (
+        runner.model_state.encoder_runner.cudagraph_manager
+        if hasattr(runner, "model_state")
+        else runner.encoder_cudagraph_manager
+    )
+    assert manager is not None and manager.is_captured()
+    model = runner.model
+    patch = runner.model_config.hf_config.vision_config.patch_size
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        num_patches = sum(t * h * w for t, h, w in grids)
+        kwargs = {
+            # The input norm takes raw 8-bit pixels.
+            "pixel_values": torch.randint(
+                0,
+                256,
+                (num_patches, 3, patch, patch),
+                device=runner.device,
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+            ),
+            "grid_thws": grids,
+        }
+        before = manager.get_cumulative_stats()
+        actual = torch.cat(manager.execute(kwargs))
+        after = manager.get_cumulative_stats()
+        assert after["graph_hits"] - before["graph_hits"] == hits
+        assert after["graph_misses"] - before["graph_misses"] == misses
+        expected = model.encoder_eager_forward(kwargs)

+        assert torch.isfinite(actual).all() and expected.abs().max() > 0
+        # Two bf16 ulps at the output scale: replay runs padded GEMMs.
+        bound = 2 * expected.abs().max().item() * 2**-7
+        diff = (actual.float() - expected.float()).abs().max().item()
+        assert diff <= bound, f"max abs diff {diff} > {bound}"
+    return manager.token_budgets

+        per_item_output = (token_budget + max_batch_size - 1) // max_batch_size
+        rope = self.vision_tower.encoder.rope_2d
+        max_output_width = rope.max_width // kw
+        max_output_height = rope.max_height // kh
+        output_width = min(math.ceil(math.sqrt(per_item_output)), max_output_width)
+        output_height = (per_item_output + output_width - 1) // output_width
+        if output_height > max_output_height:
+            output_height = max_output_height
+            output_width = (per_item_output + output_height - 1) // output_height
+        if output_width > max_output_width:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Encoder CUDA graph budget {token_budget} exceeds K3 RoPE "
+                f"capacity for max_batch_size={max_batch_size}"
+            )
+        grid_thws = [
+            [1, output_height * kh, output_width * kw] for _ in range(max_batch_size)
+        ]
+
+        patch_size: int | tuple[int, int] = self.config.vision_config.patch_size
+        if isinstance(patch_size, int):
+            patch_size = (patch_size, patch_size)
+        total_patches = sum(t * h * w for t, h, w in grid_thws)
+        pixel_values = torch.zeros(
+            total_patches,
+            3,
+            patch_size[0],
+            patch_size[1],
+            device=device,
+            dtype=self.vision_tower.patch_embed.input_norm.input_dtype or dtype,
+        )
+        metadata = self.vision_tower.prepare_encoder_cudagraph_metadata(
+            grid_thws,
+            max_batch_size=max_batch_size,
+            max_seqlen_override=max(
+                token_budget * kh * kw,
+                max(t * h * w for t, h, w in grid_thws),
+            ),
+            device=device,
+        )
+        return EncoderCudaGraphCaptureInputs(
+            values=metadata | {"pixel_values": pixel_values}
+        )
+
+    def prepare_encoder_cudagraph_replay_buffers(
+        self,
+        mm_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        max_batch_size: int,
+        max_frames_per_batch: int,
+        path: str = "default",
+    ) -> "EncoderCudaGraphReplayBuffers":
+        from vllm.v1.worker.encoder_cudagraph_defs import (
+            EncoderCudaGraphReplayBuffers,
+        )
+
+        pixel_values = self._get_pixel_values(mm_kwargs)
+        metadata = self.vision_tower.prepare_encoder_cudagraph_metadata(
+            self._get_grid_thws(mm_kwargs),
+            max_batch_size=max_batch_size,
+            device=pixel_values.device,
+        )
+        return EncoderCudaGraphReplayBuffers(
+            values=metadata | {"pixel_values": pixel_values}
+        )
+
+    def encoder_cudagraph_forward(
+        self,
+        values: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        path: str = "default",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        metadata = {k: v for k, v in values.items() if k != "pixel_values"}
+        hidden_states = self.vision_tower(
+            values["pixel_values"], None, encoder_metadata=metadata
+        )
+        dtype = next(self.mm_projector.parameters()).dtype
+        output = self.mm_projector(hidden_states.to(dtype))
+        return output.reshape(-1, output.shape[-1])
+
+    def encoder_eager_forward(
+        self,
+        mm_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        path: str = "default",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        pixel_values = self._get_pixel_values(mm_kwargs)
+        values = self.vision_tower.prepare_encoder_cudagraph_metadata(
+            self._get_grid_thws(mm_kwargs),
+            max_batch_size=None,
+            device=pixel_values.device,
+        )
+        return self.encoder_cudagraph_forward(values | {"pixel_values": pixel_values})

+def _fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm(
+    *, out: torch.Tensor, out_proj: nn.Module, **kwargs
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    fused_gdn_gated_rms_norm(out=out, **kwargs)
+    return out

+
+class Qwen3_5RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Gemma-style RMS normalization backed by Triton kernels.
+
+    When `residual` is given, the fused add + norm returns the updated
+    `(x, residual)` pair.
+
+    `reduce_inputs`: in `forward_reduced`, an `x` that comes with a
+    residual is the un-reduced TP partial of a row-parallel linear, and the
+    norm absorbs its all-reduce. An `x` without a residual (first decoder
+    layer, MTP layer) is always complete.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, hidden_size: int, eps: float = 1e-6, reduce_inputs: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(hidden_size))
+        set_weight_attrs(self.weight, {"dummy_weight_value": 0.0})
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+        self.reduce_inputs = reduce_inputs
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is None:
+            return gemma_rmsnorm(x, self.weight, self.variance_epsilon)
+        return gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm(x, residual, self.weight, self.variance_epsilon)
+
+    def forward_reduced(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """`forward` with the preceding TP all-reduce fused in when
+        `reduce_inputs`. Returns the normed activation and the residual (x
+        when `residual` is None)."""
+        if residual is None:
+            return self(x), x
+        if self.reduce_inputs:
+            return fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm(x, residual, self)
+        return self(x, residual)
+
+
+class Qwen3_5DecoderLayer(Qwen3NextDecoderLayer):
+    def __init__(

+            parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+            and parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and is_moe_layer
+        )
+        # Defer row-parallel all-reduces to the following norm
+        # (deepseek_v32 pattern); exclude PP and SP.

+            get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size() > 1
+            and parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and not self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe
+            and rocm_aiter_ops.is_custom_all_reduce_enabled()
+        )
+        # Whether this layer's MLP/MoE leaves an un-reduced partial, i.e.
+        # whether the *next* norm (or the final norm) must do the all-reduce.
+        self.mlp_output_is_partial = self.use_fused_allreduce_norm
+        reduce_results = not (
+            self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe or self.use_fused_allreduce_norm
+        )
+
+        if self.layer_type == "linear_attention":

+                config=config,
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,

+            )

+                config,
+                model_config=model_config,
+                cache_config=cache_config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+                reduce_results=reduce_results,
+                mrope_positions_factor=mrope_positions_factor(vllm_config),
+            )
+            self.self_attn.use_fused_output_gate = True
+            self.self_attn.use_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate = (
+                self.self_attn.supports_fused_qk_norm_rope_gate
+            )
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid layer_type {self.layer_type}")
+
+        if config.model_type == "qwen3_5_moe_text":
+            self.mlp = Qwen3NextSparseMoeBlock(
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=not self.use_fused_allreduce_norm,
+            )
+            if self.use_fused_allreduce_norm:
+                # reduce_results=False is only honored on the plain-TP late-AR
+                # path (skip_final_all_reduce); EP/all2all, SP, zero experts,
+                # and replicated shared experts all produce or add a complete
+                # output, which a downstream fused norm would all-reduce again.
+                # NOTE: moe_config is shared across layers; the condition is
+                # layer-uniform, so this reset is idempotent.
+                moe_config = self.mlp.experts.moe_config
+                moe_partial_ok = (
+                    moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce
+                    and moe_config.tp_size > 1
+                    and moe_config.ep_size == 1
+                    and moe_config.dp_size == 1
+                    and not self.mlp.replicate_shared_expert
+                )
+                if moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce and not moe_partial_ok:
+                    moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce = False
+                self.mlp_output_is_partial = moe_partial_ok
+        elif config.model_type == "qwen3_5_text":
+            self.mlp = Qwen3NextMLP(
+                hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+                hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=not self.use_fused_allreduce_norm,
+            )
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid model_type {config.model_type}")
+
+        # The previous layer's MLP output is a partial whenever this layer's
+        # is (layer-uniform); attention output whenever its all-reduce is
+        # deferred.
+        self.input_layernorm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            reduce_inputs=self.mlp_output_is_partial,
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            reduce_inputs=self.use_fused_allreduce_norm,
+        )
+
+        self.layer_scale = getattr(config, "layer_scale", False)
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            self.attn_layer_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.zeros(
+                    1,
+                    1,
+                    config.hidden_size,
+                ),
+            )
+            self.ffn_layer_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.zeros(
+                    1,
+                    1,
+                    config.hidden_size,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ):
+        if self.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe:
+            return super().forward(hidden_states, residual, positions, **kwargs)
+
+        # Each norm absorbs the preceding row-parallel linear's deferred
+        # all-reduce (reduce_inputs). layer_scale commutes with it.
+        hidden_states, residual = self.input_layernorm.forward_reduced(
+            hidden_states, residual
+        )
+        if self.layer_type == "linear_attention":
+            hidden_states = self.linear_attn(hidden_states)
+        else:
+            hidden_states = self.self_attn(
+                hidden_states=hidden_states, positions=positions
+            )
+
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            if len(hidden_states.shape) == 2:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.attn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype)[0] + 1
+                )
+            else:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.attn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype) + 1
+                )
+
+        hidden_states, residual = self.post_attention_layernorm.forward_reduced(
+            hidden_states, residual
+        )
+        hidden_states = self.mlp(hidden_states)
+
+        if self.layer_scale:
+            if len(hidden_states.shape) == 2:
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.ffn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype)[0] + 1
+                )
+            else:

+                    f"shape must be the same {len(hidden_states.shape)}, "
+                    f"{len(self.ffn_layer_scale.shape)}"
+                )
+                hidden_states = hidden_states * (
+                    self.ffn_layer_scale.to(hidden_states.dtype) + 1
+                )
+
+        return hidden_states, residual
+
+
