+        # Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/pull/1124
+        fc_quant = (
+            None
+            if (quant_config and quant_config.get_name() == "modelopt_fp4")
+            else quant_config
+        )
+        self.fc = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            self.config.hidden_size * 2,
+            self.config.hidden_size,
+            gather_output=True,
+            bias=False,
+            return_bias=False,
+            quant_config=fc_quant,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.fc",
+        )
+
+        # GPTQ: quantized checkpoints may exclude MTP from quantization via
+        # quantization_config.dynamic with "-:pattern" entries. When detected,
+        # disable quantization for MTP layers so they use unquantized params.
+        original_quant = vllm_config.quant_config
+        if quant_config and quant_config.get_name() not in ("modelopt_fp4",):
+            hf_qc = getattr(model_config.hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+            if isinstance(hf_qc, dict):
+                dynamic = hf_qc.get("dynamic", {})
+                if any(k.startswith("-:") and "mtp" in k for k in dynamic):
+                    vllm_config.quant_config = None
+        self.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList(
+            Qwen3_5DecoderLayer(
+                vllm_config,
+                layer_type="full_attention",
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.layers.{idx}",
+            )
+            for idx in range(self.num_mtp_layers)
+        )
+        vllm_config.quant_config = original_quant
+        self.fused_shared_expert_layers = get_fused_shared_expert_layers(
+            self,
+            Qwen3NextSparseMoeBlock,
+            enable_eplb=vllm_config.parallel_config.enable_eplb,
+        )
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = make_empty_intermediate_tensors_factory(
+            ["hidden_states", "residual"], config.hidden_size
+        )
+        self.norm = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.pre_fc_norm_hidden = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.pre_fc_norm_embedding = Qwen3_5RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # Branch on the inputs, not the rank: the drafter is built entirely on
+        # the last PP stage, where `is_first_rank` is False.
+        if intermediate_tensors is None:
+            if inputs_embeds is None:
+                inputs_embeds = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+            assert hidden_states.shape[-1] == inputs_embeds.shape[-1]
+            hidden_states = fused_pre_fc_norms(
+                inputs_embeds,
+                hidden_states,
+                self.pre_fc_norm_embedding.weight,
+                self.pre_fc_norm_hidden.weight,
+                self.pre_fc_norm_embedding.variance_epsilon,
+            )
+            hidden_states = self.fc(hidden_states)
+            residual = None
+        else:
+            hidden_states = intermediate_tensors["hidden_states"]
+            residual = intermediate_tensors["residual"]
+
+        current_step_idx = spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
+        mtp_layer = self.layers[current_step_idx]
+        if mtp_layer.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe:
+            assert hidden_states.shape[0] == positions.shape[-1]
+            hidden_states = sequence_parallel_chunk(hidden_states)
+            assert residual is None
+        hidden_states, residual = mtp_layer(
+            positions=positions,
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            residual=residual,
+        )
+
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {"hidden_states": hidden_states, "residual": residual}
+            )
+
+        if mtp_layer.mlp_output_is_partial:
+            # The MTP layer's MLP/MoE output is an un-reduced TP partial;
+            # fuse its all-reduce into the final norm.
+            hidden_states, _ = fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm(
+                hidden_states, residual, self.norm
+            )
+        else:
+            hidden_states, _ = self.norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        if mtp_layer.use_attn_reduce_scatter_for_moe:
+            hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(hidden_states, 0)
+            hidden_states = hidden_states[: positions.shape[-1]]
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        weights = maybe_fuse_shared_experts(
+            weights,
+            fused_shared_expert_layers=self.fused_shared_expert_layers,
+            n_routed_experts=getattr(self.config, "num_experts", 0),
+            n_shared_experts=1,
+            ckpt_prefix="mlp.shared_expert",
+        )
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)
+
+
+class Qwen3_5MTP(LocalArgmaxMixin, nn.Module, SupportsMultiModal, SupportsPP):
+    packed_modules_mapping = {
+        "qkv_proj": [
+            "q_proj",
+            "k_proj",
+            "v_proj",
+        ],
+        "gate_up_proj": ["gate_proj", "up_proj"],
+    }
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self.quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = config
+        self.model = Qwen3_5MultiTokenPredictor(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "mtp")
+        )
+
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+                config.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+                quant_config=self.quant_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+            )
+            if config.tie_word_embeddings:
+                self.lm_head = self.lm_head.tie_weights(self.model.embed_tokens)
+        else:
+            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()
+
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = (
+            self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        multimodal_embeddings: MultiModalEmbeddings | None = None,
+        *,
+        is_multimodal: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        inputs_embeds = self._embed_text_input_ids(
+            input_ids,
+            self.model.embed_input_ids,
+            is_multimodal=is_multimodal,
+        )
+
+        if multimodal_embeddings is None or len(multimodal_embeddings) == 0:
+            return inputs_embeds
+
+        is_multimodal = _require_is_multimodal(is_multimodal)
+
+        inputs_embeds = _merge_multimodal_embeddings(
+            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
+            multimodal_embeddings=multimodal_embeddings,
+            is_multimodal=is_multimodal,
+        )
+
+        return inputs_embeds
+
+    def forward(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ):
+        hidden_states = self.model(
+            input_ids,
+            positions,
+            hidden_states,
+            intermediate_tensors,
+            inputs_embeds,
+            spec_step_idx,
+        )
+        return hidden_states
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def get_top_tokens(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # One lm_head is shared by all MTP modules, as in compute_logits.
+        return super().get_top_tokens(hidden_states)
+
+    def is_unused_checkpoint_weight(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return not name.startswith("mtp.") and not any(
+            key in name for key in ["embed_tokens", "lm_head"]
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        def remap_weight_names(weights):
+            for name, weight in weights:
+                if self.is_unused_checkpoint_weight(name):
+                    continue
+                if name.startswith("mtp."):
+                    name = name.replace("mtp.", "model.")
+                elif "embed_tokens" in name:
+                    name = name.replace("language_model.", "")
+                yield name, weight
+
+        loader = AutoWeightsLoader(self)
+        return loader.load_weights(remap_weight_names(weights))
+
+
+class Qwen3_5MoeMTP(Qwen3_5MTP, QwenNextMixtureOfExperts):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix)
+        self.set_moe_parameters()

+group: Hardware - AMD ROCm Image Cache
+
+# /ci rocm cache starts a main build that runs only this step (VLLM_CI_ONLY_STEP_KEYS): build.sh promote
+# copies the ROCm images a PR's CI built into rocm/vllm-ci. In image_build/, which only the main CI
+# pipeline renders (ci-infra's AMD pipeline renders all of hardware_tests/). Optional, so other
+# builds skip it; nightlies run optional steps, and without a request build.sh exits at once.
+steps:
+  - label: ":docker: Cache a PR's ROCm images for main"
+    key: rocm-base-image-cache
+    depends_on: []
+    device: amd_cpu
+    no_plugin: true
+    optional: true
+    commands:

+    timeout_in_minutes: 30
+    retry:

+          limit: 1
+        - exit_status: -1  # Agent was lost
+          limit: 1
+        - exit_status: -10  # Agent was lost
+          limit: 1

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""PyTorch definitions of what the Ampere kernels compute.
+
+Each function here is the specification one CuTe DSL kernel of this package
+implements: the same formats, the same rounding, the same order of FP32
+operations where it decides a bit. The tests compare every kernel with its
+function.
+
+Formats (all little-endian bytes, as on SM100):
+
+* E2M1 (FP4): a sign bit and a 3-bit code of magnitudes
+  {0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6}; two codes per byte, the even element in the
+  low nibble.
+* E4M3 (FP8, `float8_e4m3fn`) and UE8M0 (a power of two `2^(b - 127)`;
+  the byte 0 decodes to 0, as the kernels build the FP32 exponent field from
+  it).
+* MXFP4: E2M1 values with one UE8M0 scale per 32 elements, the scale being
+  `2^ceil(log2(amax / 6))`.
+* NVFP4 (the 288-byte compressed KV record): E2M1 values with one E4M3 scale
+  per 16 elements, the scale being `amax / 6` rounded to E4M3.
+* MXFP8 (the 528-byte sliding-window KV record): E4M3 values with one UE8M0
+  scale per 32 elements.
+
+Quantizers round to nearest, ties to even, and saturate, as the SM100
+conversion instructions do.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+E2M1_MAGNITUDES = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0)
+# float32(1 / 6), the factor every quantizer here applies to the block amax.
+ONE_SIXTH = torch.tensor(1.0 / 6.0, dtype=torch.float32).item()
+
+
+def ue8m0_to_f32(codes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """UE8M0 bytes to FP32: the byte is the FP32 exponent field."""
+    return (codes.to(torch.int32) << 23).view(torch.float32)
+
+
+def e2m1_to_f32(codes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """4-bit E2M1 codes (an int tensor) to FP32."""
+    codes = codes.to(torch.int64)
+    table = torch.tensor(E2M1_MAGNITUDES, dtype=torch.float32, device=codes.device)
+    magnitude = table[codes & 7]
+    return torch.where((codes & 8) != 0, -magnitude, magnitude)
+
+
+def e4m3_to_f32(codes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """E4M3 bytes to FP32."""
+    return codes.contiguous().view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32)
+
+
+def f32_to_e2m1(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FP32 to 4-bit E2M1 codes (int32), nearest-even and saturating.
+
+    The magnitude code counts the rounding thresholds below `|x|`; at a
+    threshold exactly, the even code wins (0.75, 1.75, 3.5 round up; 0.25,
+    1.25, 2.5, 5 round down). The sign bit follows `x`'s, zero included.
+    """
+    a = x.abs()
+    code = (
+        (a > 0.25).int()
+        + (a >= 0.75).int()
+        + (a > 1.25).int()
+        + (a >= 1.75).int()
+        + (a > 2.5).int()
+        + (a >= 3.5).int()
+        + (a > 5.0).int()
+    )
+    return code | (torch.signbit(x).int() << 3)
+
+
+def f32_to_e4m3(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FP32 within the E4M3 range to E4M3 bytes, nearest-even."""
+    return x.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def ceil_log2(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """`ceil(log2(x))` of positive normal FP32 values, exactly (int32)."""
+    bits = x.contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+    exponent = ((bits >> 23) & 0xFF) - 127
+    return exponent + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).int()
+
+
+def mxfp4_quantize(x: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """FP32 `[..., D]` to MXFP4: packed values `[..., D / 2]` and UE8M0
+    scales `[..., D / 32]` (uint8)."""
+    blocks = x.float().unflatten(-1, (-1, 32))
+    amax = blocks.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(6.0 * 2.0**-126)
+    exponent = ceil_log2(amax * ONE_SIXTH).clamp(-127, 127)
+    inverse = ue8m0_to_f32(127 - exponent)
+    codes = f32_to_e2m1(blocks * inverse.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+    packed = codes[..., 0::2] | (codes[..., 1::2] << 4)
+    return packed.to(torch.uint8), (exponent + 127).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mxfp4_dequantize(packed: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """MXFP4 values `[..., D / 2]` and scales `[..., D / 32]` to FP32."""
+    codes = torch.stack((packed & 0xF, packed >> 4), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
+    values = e2m1_to_f32(codes).unflatten(-1, (-1, 32))
+    return (values * ue8m0_to_f32(scales).unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def mxfp8_weight_dequantize(codes: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """An MXFP8 weight `[N, K]` (E4M3 bytes) with one UE8M0 scale per
+    32 x 32 block (`[N / 32, K / 32]`, `2^(s - 127)` for every byte
+    `s`) as BF16: the product in FP32, which is exact, rounded to BF16, as
+    the load-time dequantization computes it."""
+    factors = torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127.0)
+    factors = factors.repeat_interleave(32, 0).repeat_interleave(32, 1)
+    return (e4m3_to_f32(codes) * factors).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def mxfp8_linear(
+    x: torch.Tensor, codes: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """`x [M, K] . dequant(W)^T` in FP64 (`mxfp8_weight_dequantize`); the
+    kernel's result is this sum in FP32, in its own order, rounded to BF16."""
+    weight = mxfp8_weight_dequantize(codes, scales)
+    return x.double() @ weight.double().t()
+
+
+def rope_pairs(
+    x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor, inverse: bool = False
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """GPT-J (interleaved) RoPE of FP32 `x [..., 2 P]` with `cos`/`sin`
+    `[..., P]`: each product rounded, then the difference or sum."""
+    even, odd = x[..., 0::2], x[..., 1::2]
+    if inverse:
+        new_even = even * cos + odd * sin
+        new_odd = odd * cos - even * sin
+    else:
+        new_even = even * cos - odd * sin
+        new_odd = odd * cos + even * sin
+    return torch.stack((new_even, new_odd), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def _cos_sin(cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor):
+    """`cos`/`sin` FP32 rows `[T, 32]` of a [max_pos, 64] cache."""
+    rows = cos_sin_cache[positions.long()].float()
+    return rows[:, :32], rows[:, 32:64]
+
+
+def indexer_q_rope_quant(
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    weights_scale: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Indexer queries `q [T, H, 128]` (BF16; RoPE on dims 64-127) to MXFP4.
+
+    Returns values `[T, H, 64]`, scales `[T, H, 4]` and the FP32 head
+    weights `weights * weights_scale` (the softmax and head scales).
+    """
+    x = q.float()
+    cos, sin = _cos_sin(cos_sin_cache, positions)
+    rope = rope_pairs(x[..., 64:], cos[:, None], sin[:, None])
+    x = torch.cat((x[..., :64], rope.bfloat16().float()), dim=-1)
+    values, scales = mxfp4_quantize(x)
+    return values, scales, weights.float() * weights_scale
+
+
+def indexer_k_norm_rope(
+    k_pre: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    compress_ratio: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Index keys `[T, 128]` (BF16): RMSNorm (BF16 rounded), RoPE at the
+    group's first position (BF16 rounded), MXFP4 (values `[T, 64]`, scales
+    `[T, 4]`). Rows that are not group boundaries are computed too."""
+    k = k_pre.float()
+    variance = (k * k).sum(-1, keepdim=True) / k.shape[-1]
+    k = (k * torch.rsqrt(variance + eps) * norm_weight.float()).bfloat16().float()
+    first = positions.long() // compress_ratio * compress_ratio
+    cos, sin = _cos_sin(cos_sin_cache, first)
+    rope = rope_pairs(k[:, 64:], cos, sin).bfloat16().float()
+    return mxfp4_quantize(torch.cat((k[:, :64], rope), dim=-1))
+
+
+def index_key_pages(k_cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The pages `[blocks, page_bytes]` of an indexer key cache whose first
+    two dims are `[blocks, block_size]` (its 3-D allocation or the 4-D view
+    the logits kernels take). Each page holds its block's 64-byte values, then
+    their 4-byte scales; pages may be padded."""
+    return torch.as_strided(
+        k_cache, (k_cache.shape[0], k_cache.stride(0)), (k_cache.stride(0), 1)
+    )
+
+
+def store_index_keys(
+    values: torch.Tensor,
+    scales: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+    compress_ratio: int,
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Store MXFP4 index keys of group-boundary rows into the paged cache
+    `[blocks, block_size, 68]` (uint8; each page holds its block's values,
+    then their scales)."""
+    block_size = k_cache.shape[1]
+    pages = index_key_pages(k_cache)
+    n = slot_mapping.numel()
+    slots = slot_mapping.long()
+    keep = (slots >= 0) & ((positions[:n].long() + 1) % compress_ratio == 0)
+    slots, values, scales = slots[keep], values[:n][keep], scales[:n][keep]
+    page, row = slots // block_size, slots % block_size
+    cols = torch.arange(64, device=slots.device)
+    pages[page[:, None], (row * 64)[:, None] + cols] = values
+    cols = torch.arange(4, device=slots.device)
+    pages[page[:, None], (block_size * 64 + row * 4)[:, None] + cols] = scales
+
+
+def nvfp4_kv_record(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    compress_ratio: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compressed KV latents `[T, 512]` (BF16) to 288-byte NVFP4 records:
+    RoPE (FP32, not rounded) on dims 448-511 at the group's first position,
+    then 256 bytes of E2M1 pairs and 32 E4M3 scales of 16 dims."""
+    x = latent.float()
+    first = positions.long() // compress_ratio * compress_ratio
+    cos, sin = _cos_sin(cos_sin_cache, first)
+    x = torch.cat((x[:, :448], rope_pairs(x[:, 448:], cos, sin)), dim=-1)
+    tiles = x.unflatten(-1, (32, 16))
+    amax = tiles.abs().amax(-1)
+    scale_codes = f32_to_e4m3((amax * ONE_SIXTH).clamp(2.0**-9, 448.0))
+    scale = e4m3_to_f32(scale_codes)
+    codes = f32_to_e2m1(tiles / scale.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+    packed = (codes[:, 0::2] | (codes[:, 1::2] << 4)).to(torch.uint8)
+    return torch.cat((packed, scale_codes), dim=-1)
+
+
+def decode_mxfp8_record(records: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """528-byte MXFP8 KV records `[..., 528]` to FP32 `[..., 512]`."""
+    values = e4m3_to_f32(records[..., :512]).unflatten(-1, (16, 32))
+    scales = ue8m0_to_f32(records[..., 512:528])
+    return (values * scales.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def decode_nvfp4_record(records: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """288-byte NVFP4 KV records `[..., 288]` to FP32 `[..., 512]`."""
+    packed = records[..., :256]
+    codes = torch.stack((packed & 0xF, packed >> 4), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
+    values = e2m1_to_f32(codes).unflatten(-1, (32, 16))
+    scales = e4m3_to_f32(records[..., 256:288])
+    return (values * scales.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def store_v4_records(cache: torch.Tensor, slots: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Store FP32 rows `x [n, 512]` at `slots` of a V4-record cache
+    `[blocks, block_size, 584]`: dims 0-447 as E4M3 with one UE8M0 scale per
+    64 (`2^ceil(log2(amax / 448))`), dims 448-511 as BF16. Each page holds
+    its tokens' 576 value bytes, then their 8 scale bytes (the last zero)."""
+    block_size = cache.shape[1]
+    pages = index_key_pages(cache)
+    blocks = x[:, :448].unflatten(-1, (7, 64))
+    amax = blocks.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(2.0**-100)
+    exponent = ceil_log2(amax / 448).clamp(-127, 127)
+    fp8 = f32_to_e4m3(blocks / ue8m0_to_f32(exponent + 127).unsqueeze(-1))
+    rope = x[:, 448:].bfloat16().view(torch.uint8)
+    values = torch.cat((fp8.flatten(-2), rope), dim=-1)
+    scales = torch.cat(
+        ((exponent + 127).to(torch.uint8), exponent.new_zeros(len(x), 1).byte()), -1
+    )
+    page, row = slots.long() // block_size, slots.long() % block_size
+    cols = torch.arange(576, device=x.device)
+    pages[page[:, None], (row * 576)[:, None] + cols] = values
+    cols = torch.arange(8, device=x.device)
+    pages[page[:, None], (block_size * 576 + row * 8)[:, None] + cols] = scales
+
+
+def decode_v4_records(cache: torch.Tensor, slots: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The V4 records at `slots` (any shape) of `cache` as FP32
+    `[..., 512]`."""
+    block_size = cache.shape[1]
+    pages = index_key_pages(cache)
+    page, row = slots.long() // block_size, slots.long() % block_size
+    cols = torch.arange(576, device=cache.device)
+    values = pages[page[..., None], (row * 576)[..., None] + cols]
+    cols = torch.arange(7, device=cache.device)
+    scales = pages[page[..., None], (block_size * 576 + row * 8)[..., None] + cols]
+    fp8 = e4m3_to_f32(values[..., :448]).unflatten(-1, (7, 64))
+    fp8 = (fp8 * ue8m0_to_f32(scales).unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+    rope = values[..., 448:].contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).float()
+    return torch.cat((fp8, rope), dim=-1)
+
+
+def _gather_records(cache: torch.Tensor, slots: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Records of global `slots` from a paged cache [blocks, block_size, W]."""
+    block_size = cache.shape[1]
+    slots = slots.long()
+    return cache[slots // block_size, slots % block_size]
+
+
+def sparse_mla(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    swa_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    swa_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    swa_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    compressed_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    compressed_indices: torch.Tensor | None,
+    compressed_lens: torch.Tensor | None,
+    sink: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: float,
+    positions: torch.Tensor | None,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    chunk: int = 64,
+    v4_records: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Sparse MLA of BF16 queries `q [T, H, 512]` over each token's window
+    keys (528-byte records at `swa_indices[t, :swa_lens[t]]`) and compressed
+    keys (288-byte records at `compressed_indices[t, :compressed_lens[t]]`);
+    a negative slot in either list names no key. `v4_records` reads both
+    caches as 584-byte V4 records instead.
+
+    Keys double as values. Per head: `softmax` with the sink logit
+    `sink[h]` in the denominator, FP32 throughout; the output is rounded to
+    BF16, inverse-RoPE'd on dims 448-511 at the token's position and rounded
+    to BF16 again (the input `wo_a` takes). Without `positions` and
+    `cos_sin_cache` the RoPE dims stay rotated. Tokens without keys output
+    0.
+    """
+
+    def decode(cache: torch.Tensor, slots: torch.Tensor, nvfp4: bool):
+        if v4_records:
+            return decode_v4_records(cache, slots)
+        records = _gather_records(cache, slots)
+        return decode_nvfp4_record(records) if nvfp4 else decode_mxfp8_record(records)
+
+    out = torch.empty_like(q)
+    for start in range(0, q.shape[0], chunk):
+        rows = slice(start, min(start + chunk, q.shape[0]))
+        keys, valid = [], []
+        width = swa_indices.shape[-1]
+        lanes = torch.arange(width, device=q.device)
+        valid.append((lanes < swa_lens[rows, None]) & (swa_indices[rows] >= 0))
+        slots = torch.where(valid[-1], swa_indices[rows], 0)
+        keys.append(decode(swa_cache, slots, False))
+        if compressed_cache is not None:
+            assert compressed_indices is not None and compressed_lens is not None
+            width = compressed_indices.shape[-1]
+            lanes = torch.arange(width, device=q.device)
+            valid.append(
+                (lanes < compressed_lens[rows, None]) & (compressed_indices[rows] >= 0)
+            )
+            slots = torch.where(valid[-1], compressed_indices[rows], 0)
+            keys.append(decode(compressed_cache, slots, True))
+        k = torch.cat(keys, dim=1)  # [t, L, 512], BF16-exact values
+        mask = torch.cat(valid, dim=1)  # [t, L]
+        scores = torch.einsum("thd,tld->thl", q[rows].float(), k) * scale
+        scores = scores.masked_fill(~mask[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
+        top = torch.maximum(scores.amax(-1), sink.float())
+        p = torch.exp(scores - top[..., None])
+        denominator = p.sum(-1) + torch.exp(sink.float() - top)
+        o = torch.einsum("thl,tld->thd", p, k) / denominator[..., None]
+        o = o.bfloat16().float()
+        if cos_sin_cache is not None:
+            assert positions is not None
+            cos, sin = _cos_sin(cos_sin_cache, positions[rows])
+            o[..., 448:] = rope_pairs(
+                o[..., 448:], cos[:, None], sin[:, None], inverse=True
+            )
+        o = torch.where(mask.any(-1)[:, None, None], o, 0.0)
+        out[rows] = o.bfloat16()
+    return out
+
+
+def mqa_logits(
+    q_values: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scales: torch.Tensor,
+    k_values: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scales: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Indexer logits of MXFP4 queries `[M, H, 64]` (+ scales `[M, H, 4]`)
+    against MXFP4 keys `[N, 64]` (+ `[N, 4]`): `sum_h weights[m, h] *
+    relu(q[m, h] . k[n])`, FP32 `[M, N]`."""
+    q = mxfp4_dequantize(q_values, q_scales)
+    k = mxfp4_dequantize(k_values, k_scales)
+    scores = torch.einsum("mhd,nd->mhn", q, k).relu()
+    return (scores * weights.float().unsqueeze(-1)).sum(1)
+
+
+def gather_index_keys(
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor, block_table: torch.Tensor, length: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The first `length` MXFP4 keys of one request from the paged indexer
+    cache: values `[length, 64]` and scales `[length, 4]`."""
+    block_size = k_cache.shape[1]
+    pages = index_key_pages(k_cache)
+    position = torch.arange(length, device=k_cache.device)
+    page = block_table[position // block_size].long()
+    row = position % block_size
+    values = pages[
+        page[:, None], (row * 64)[:, None] + torch.arange(64, device=row.device)
+    ]
+    scales = pages[
+        page[:, None],
+        (block_size * 64 + row * 4)[:, None] + torch.arange(4, device=row.device),
+    ]
+    return values, scales
+
+
+def candidate_mask(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    lens: torch.Tensor,
+    candidates: torch.Tensor,
+    block: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Decode logits `[rows, width]` with every key of row `m` below
+    `lens[m]` whose block of `block` keys is not among the row's
+    `candidates` (`-1` padded) set to `-inf`."""
+    out = logits.clone()
+    for row in range(logits.shape[0]):
+        n = int(lens[row])
+        keep = torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.bool, device=logits.device)
+        blocks = candidates[row][candidates[row] >= 0].long()
+        keys = blocks[:, None] * block + torch.arange(block, device=blocks.device)
+        keys = keys.flatten()
+        keep[keys[keys < n]] = True
+        out[row, :n] = torch.where(keep, logits[row, :n], float("-inf"))
+    return out
+
+
+def decode_topk(
+    logits: torch.Tensor, lens: torch.Tensor, k: int, group: int = 1
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The `k` best of each row's first `lens[row]` scores, or of its
+    blocks of `group` scores (a block scores its maximum; the newest block
+    is pinned first): int32 `[rows, k]` in ascending order, `-1` padded;
+    ties at the threshold go to the lowest indices."""
+    rows, width = logits.shape
+    out = torch.full((rows, k), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+    for row in range(rows):
+        n = max(0, min(int(lens[row]), width))
+        scores = logits[row, :n]
+        if group > 1:
+            blocks = (n + group - 1) // group
+            padded = scores.new_full((blocks * group,), float("-inf"))
+            padded[:n] = scores
+            scores = padded.view(blocks, group).amax(-1)
+            if blocks:
+                scores[blocks - 1] = float("inf")
+            n = blocks
+        if n <= k:
+            out[row, :n] = torch.arange(n, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+            continue
+        best = torch.sort(-scores, stable=True).indices[:k]
+        out[row] = torch.sort(best).values.int()
+    return out
+
+
+def mhc_post(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_mix: torch.Tensor,
+    comb_mix: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The mHC post-mix: `r'[j] = post[j] x + sum_k comb[k, j] r[k]` of the
+    `[rows, 4, hidden]` BF16 streams, rounded to BF16."""
+    mixed = torch.einsum("nkj,nkh->njh", comb_mix.double(), residual.double())
+    mixed = mixed + post_mix.double().view(-1, 4, 1) * x.double()[:, None, :]
+    return mixed.bfloat16()
+
+
+def mhc_post_collapse(
+    x: torch.Tensor | None,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+    comb_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+    pre_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    write_aux: bool = False,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A sublayer boundary's critical path: the streams (post-mixed with
+    `x`, else `residual` itself), the next layer input -- the RMSNorm of
+    the streams collapsed with the carried pre-mix (stream zero without one),
+    the collapse rounded to BF16 before the norm -- and, with `write_aux`,
+    the BF16 stream mean."""
+    streams = residual if x is None else mhc_post(x, residual, post_mix, comb_mix)
+    if pre_mix is None:
+        pre_mix = torch.zeros(residual.shape[0], 4, device=residual.device)
+        pre_mix[:, 0] = 1
+    collapsed = (pre_mix.double()[:, :, None] * streams.double()).sum(1)
+    collapsed = collapsed.bfloat16().double()
+    inverse_rms = torch.rsqrt(collapsed.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    layer_input = (collapsed * inverse_rms * norm_weight.double()).bfloat16()
+    aux = streams.double().mean(1).bfloat16()
+    return streams, layer_input, aux if write_aux else aux[:0]
+
+
+def mhc_coefficients(
+    x: torch.Tensor | None,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+    comb_mix: torch.Tensor | None,
+    fn: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    hc_base: torch.Tensor,
+    rms_eps: float,
+    pre_eps: float,
+    sinkhorn_eps: float,
+    post_mult: float,
+    sinkhorn_repeat: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The next boundary's post-, comb- and pre-mix (FP32) from the BF16
+    streams (`mhc_post` of `x` when given, else `residual`, which may
+    also be one `[rows, hidden]` row): 24 projections scaled by the
+    streams' inverse RMS, sigmoids, and a softmax followed by alternating
+    column and row normalizations (`sinkhorn_repeat` column steps)."""
+    streams = residual if x is None else mhc_post(x, residual, post_mix, comb_mix)

+REPLAYS = 50
+# The stress run's graphs: three all-reduces of these rows each.
+STRESS_ROWS = ((6, 96, 24), (128, 1, 48), (12, 128, 6))
+
+
+def _late(rank: int, step: int) -> None:
+    """Delay one rank per step, a different one each step."""
+    if rank == step % TP:
+        torch.cuda._sleep(LATE_CYCLES)
+
+
+def _partial(rows: int, rank: int, seed: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's partial sum, with +0/-0 pairs that look like the Lamport
+    sentinel."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(97 * rank + 1009 * seed)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=generator, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    x[:, :16] = 0
+    x[:, 9:16:2] = -0.0
+    return x
+
+
+def _assert_reduced(out: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """`out` is within one BF16 ulp of the FP32 sum of every rank's `x`
+    and bitwise the same on every rank."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    rows = x.shape[0]
+    partials = group.all_gather(x, dim=0).view(TP, rows, HIDDEN)
+    want = partials.float().sum(0)
+    ulp = torch.maximum(want.abs(), torch.full_like(want, 2**-126)) * 2**-7
+    assert ((out.float() - want).abs() <= ulp).all(), rows
+    outs = group.all_gather(out, dim=0).view(TP, rows, HIDDEN)
+    assert torch.equal(outs.view(torch.int16), out.expand(TP, -1, -1).view(torch.int16))
+
+
+def _moe(
+    rows: int, rank: int, seed: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """This rank's unweighted route rows, routing weights and shared row."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(89 * rank + 1013 * seed)
+    routes = _partial(rows * TOP_K, rank, seed)
+    weights = torch.rand(rows, TOP_K, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    return routes, weights, _partial(rows, rank, seed + 7)
+
+
+def _moe_partial(routes, weights, shared) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The partial row as the finalize kernel forms it: an FP32 fused
+    multiply-add per route (the FP64 product of a BF16 and an FP32 value is
+    exact), the shared row added in FP32, rounded to BF16."""
+    v = routes.view(-1, TOP_K, HIDDEN).double()
+    w = weights.double()
+    acc = (v[:, 0] * w[:, :1]).float()
+    for k in range(1, TOP_K):
+        acc = (v[:, k] * w[:, k : k + 1] + acc.double()).float()
+    return (acc + shared.float()).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _boundary(
+    rows: int, seed: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A boundary's streams, post-, comb- and pre-mix and norm weight, the
+    same on every rank."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    streams = torch.randn(rows, 4, HIDDEN, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    post = torch.rand(rows, 4, 1, generator=generator, device="cuda") * 2
+    comb = torch.rand(rows, 4, 4, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    pre = torch.rand(rows, 4, generator=generator, device="cuda") + 1e-6
+    weight = torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    return streams.bfloat16(), post, comb, pre, weight.bfloat16()
+
+
+def _assert_post_collapsed(reduce, x, boundary, pre, write_aux, got) -> None:
+    """`got` is bitwise the all-reduce of `x` followed by
+    `mhc_post_collapse`."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere.mhc import (
+        mhc_post_collapse,
+    )
+
+    streams, post, comb, _, weight = boundary
+    want = mhc_post_collapse(
+        reduce(x), streams, post.view(-1, 4), comb, pre, weight, EPS, write_aux
+    )
+    for out, expected in zip(got, want):
+        assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16))
+
+
+def _check(rank: int) -> None:
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops import mhc
+
+    reduce = mhc._ampere_all_reduce
+    assert reduce is not None
+    step = 0
+    ctas = reduce.ctas
+    for seed, rows in enumerate([1, 6, 24, 96, 128, 7, 24, 96, 1, 128] * 2):
+        reduce.ctas = 5 if seed % 2 else ctas
+        x = _partial(rows, rank, seed)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        _assert_reduced(reduce(x), x)
+    for seed, rows in enumerate([1, 6, 96, 128, 7, 24]):
+        x = _partial(rows, rank, 400 + seed)
+        boundary = _boundary(rows, seed)
+        streams, post, comb, pre, weight = boundary
+        pre = None if seed % 3 == 2 else pre
+        write_aux = seed % 2 == 1
+        reduce.ctas = 5 if seed % 2 else ctas
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = reduce.post_collapse(x, streams, post, comb, pre, weight, EPS, write_aux)
+        _assert_post_collapsed(reduce, x, boundary, pre, write_aux, got)
+    for seed, rows in enumerate([1, 6, 96, 128, 7, 24]):
+        moe = _moe(rows, rank, 500 + seed)
+        boundary = _boundary(rows, 500 + seed)
+        streams, post, comb, pre, weight = boundary
+        pre = None if seed % 3 == 2 else pre
+        write_aux = seed % 2 == 1
+        reduce.ctas = 5 if seed % 2 else ctas
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = reduce.finalize_post_collapse(
+            *moe, streams, post, comb, pre, weight, EPS, write_aux
+        )
+        want = reduce.post_collapse(
+            _moe_partial(*moe), streams, post, comb, pre, weight, EPS, write_aux
+        )
+        for out, expected in zip(got, want):
+            assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16))
+    reduce.ctas = ctas
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier(get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    assert (reduce.mailbox.view(torch.int16) == -32768).all()
+    assert int(reduce.generations.min()) >= 0 and int(reduce.generations.max()) < 3
+
+    # One graph of two calls, a fused and a finalizing one, replayed with
+    # new inputs.
+    xa = _partial(24, rank, 100)
+    xb = _partial(48, rank, 101)
+    xc = _partial(6, rank, 102)
+    moe = _moe(6, rank, 103)
+    boundary = _boundary(6, 102)
+    fused = partial(reduce.post_collapse, xc, *boundary, EPS, False)
+    finalize = partial(reduce.finalize_post_collapse, *moe, *boundary, EPS, False)
+    reduce(xa), reduce(xb), fused(), finalize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        out_a = reduce(xa)
+        out_b = reduce(xb)
+        out_c = fused()
+        out_d = finalize()
+    for replay in range(REPLAYS):
+        xa.copy_(_partial(24, rank, 200 + replay))
+        xb.copy_(_partial(48, rank, 300 + replay))
+        xc.copy_(_partial(6, rank, 400 + replay))
+        for tensor, new in zip(moe, _moe(6, rank, 600 + replay)):
+            tensor.copy_(new)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        graph.replay()
+        _assert_reduced(out_a, xa)
+        _assert_reduced(out_b, xb)
+        _assert_post_collapsed(reduce, xc, boundary, boundary[3], False, out_c)
+        want = reduce.post_collapse(_moe_partial(*moe), *boundary, EPS, False)
+        for out, expected in zip(out_d[:2], want[:2]):
+            assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16))
+
+    # The boundary dispatch falls back above the kernel's capacity.
+    calls: list[str] = []
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    original = group.all_reduce
+
+    def all_reduce(x):
+        calls.append("group")
+        return original(x)
+
+    group.all_reduce = all_reduce  # type: ignore[method-assign]
+    try:
+        for rows in (reduce.capacity, reduce.capacity + 1):
+            x = _partial(rows, rank, rows)
+            _assert_reduced(mhc.boundary_all_reduce(x), x)
+    finally:
+        group.all_reduce = original  # type: ignore[method-assign]
+    assert calls == ["group"]
+
+
+def _stress_value(t: torch.Tensor, rank: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Rank `rank`'s stress input for residues `t` (0..60)."""
+    return (t * (2 * rank + 3)) % 61 - 30
+
+
+def _stress_graph(reduce, rank, sizes, counter, errors, skew):
+    """A CUDA graph of three all-reduces whose inputs follow the replay
+    counter on the device: small integers, so every sum is exact. It adds the
+    output elements that differ from the expected sum to `errors`."""
+    index = [
+        torch.arange(rows * HIDDEN, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(rows, -1)
+        for rows in sizes
+    ]
+    inputs = [
+        torch.empty(rows, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") for rows in sizes
+    ]
+
+    def body():
+        counter.add_(1)
+        for kind, (idx, x) in enumerate(zip(index, inputs)):
+            t = (idx + 7 * (counter % 61) + 13 * kind) % 61
+            x.copy_(_stress_value(t, rank))
+            if skew:
+                torch.cuda._sleep(LATE_CYCLES * ((rank + kind) % TP))
+            out = reduce(x)
+            want = sum(_stress_value(t, r) for r in range(TP))
+            errors.add_((out.float() != want).sum())
+
+    body()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        body()
+    # The graph keeps raw pointers: keep its tensors alive too.
+    return graph, (index, inputs)
+
+
+def _check_replays(rank: int, replays: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """The stress graphs replayed in one seeded random order on every rank;
+    returns the replays run and the mismatched elements summed over the
+    ranks, which all stop after the first block of 1000 replays with a
+    mismatch."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops import mhc
+
+    reduce = mhc._ampere_all_reduce
+    assert reduce is not None
+    counter = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    errors = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    graphs = [
+        _stress_graph(reduce, rank, sizes, counter, errors, skew)
+        for sizes in STRESS_ROWS
+        for skew in (False, True)
+    ]
+    order = random.Random(1234)
+    total = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64)
+    done = 0
+    while done < replays:
+        for _ in range(min(1000, replays - done)):
+            graphs[order.randrange(len(graphs))][0].replay()
+        done = min(done + 1000, replays)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        # Every rank stops after the same block, or the others would wait.
+        total[0] = errors.item()
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(total, group=get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+        if total.item():
+            break
+    return done, int(total.item())
+
+
+def _worker(rank: int, port: str, skip_path: str, replays: int) -> None:
+    from tests.utils import init_test_distributed_environment
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import cleanup_dist_env_and_memory, get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops import mhc
+
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()), torch.inference_mode():
+        init_test_distributed_environment(TP, 1, rank, port, local_rank=rank)
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                tensor_parallel_size=TP, enable_expert_parallel=False
+            ),
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                hf_config=SimpleNamespace(hidden_size=HIDDEN, num_experts_per_tok=TOP_K)
+            ),
+        )
+        supported = torch.tensor([int(mhc.supports_ampere_all_reduce(config))])
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+            supported, torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, get_tp_group().cpu_group
+        )
+        if not supported.item():
+            if rank == 0:
+                with open(skip_path, "w") as f:
+                    f.write("vLLM's custom all-reduce is off: no full peer access")
+            cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+            return
+        mhc.init_ampere_all_reduce(config)
+        if replays:
+            done, errors = _check_replays(rank, replays)
+            if rank == 0:
+                print(
+                    f"{done} replays ({3 * done} all-reduces) on {TP} "
+                    f"ranks: {errors} mismatched elements"
+                )
+            assert errors == 0
+        else:
+            _check(rank)
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+def _spawn(replays: int) -> str | None:
+    """Run the checks (or the stress replays) on eight GPUs; returns why they
+    were skipped, if they were."""
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < TP:
+        return "needs eight GPUs"
+    from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        skip_path = os.path.join(tmp, "skipped")
+        torch.multiprocessing.spawn(
+            _worker, args=(str(get_open_port()), skip_path, replays), nprocs=TP
+        )
+        if os.path.exists(skip_path):
+            with open(skip_path) as f:
+                return f.read()
+    return None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.distributed(num_gpus=8)
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_device_capability(80), reason="needs SM80")
+def test_ampere_all_reduce():
+    skipped = _spawn(0)
+    if skipped:
+        pytest.skip(skipped)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
+    parser.add_argument("--replays", type=int, default=2_000_000)
+    skipped = _spawn(parser.parse_args().replays)
+    if skipped:
+        print(f"skipped: {skipped}")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The SM80 MXFP8 decode GEMM (`gemv.py`) against its PyTorch reference
+and cuBLAS.
+
+* Weight decoding, exact: rows of `x` that select single columns return
+  the load-time BF16 dequantization of those weight columns exactly (as
+  values; a negative-zero weight comes back as +0), over every E4M3 code
+  and random scale bytes from 1 to 134.
+* The decode-step shapes of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at TP8 at 1, 6, 24 and 48
+  rows: within one BF16 ulp of the FP64 product of the dequantized weights
+  plus an FP32-accumulation term (only the summation order differs), and
+  within twice that bound of cuBLAS on the BF16 weights with FP32 split-K
+  reductions (PyTorch's default lets cuBLAS reduce split-K partial sums in
+  BF16, which on some shapes errs by 20-30 times the bound); bitwise
+  repeatable.
+* Column splits over warps and CTAs (the ticket path), which change only
+  the FP32 summation order, and the self-resetting ticket counters.
+* The row-expanded scale copy the loader keeps, and CUDA-graph replay.
+
+The kernel uses SM80 instructions only, so any SM80-or-newer GPU runs it.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from . import reference
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda() or not current_platform.has_device_capability(80),
+    reason="needs an SM80-or-newer CUDA GPU",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+
+# Per-rank [N, K] at TP8: fused qkv (q_a, kv, index key), q_b without and
+# with the indexer's query projection, wo_b, the shared expert's w13 and w2.
+SHAPES = [
+    (1792, 5120),
+    (4096, 1280),
+    (8192, 1280),
+    (5120, 1024),
+    (576, 5120),
+    (5120, 288),
+]
+
+
+def _weight(
+    n: int, k: int, low: int, high: int, seed: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Random E4M3 bytes (no NaN codes) and UE8M0 bytes in `[low, high]`."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    codes = torch.randint(0, 256, (n, k), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    codes[(codes & 0x7F) == 0x7F] -= 1
+    scales = torch.randint(
+        low, high + 1, (n // 32, k // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE, generator=g
+    )
+    return codes, scales
+
+
+def _bound(x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, want: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """One BF16 ulp of `want` plus 2^-16 of the sum of absolute products."""
+    magnitude = x.double().abs() @ weight.double().abs().t()
+    ulp = torch.exp2(torch.floor(torch.log2(want.abs().clamp_min(2.0**-100))) - 7)
+    return ulp + magnitude * 2.0**-16
+
+
+def test_decode_bitwise():
+    """Single-column rows of x return dequantized weights exactly."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import gemv
+
+    n, k = 576, 1024
+    codes, scales = _weight(n, k, 1, 134, seed=0)
+    # Every byte value b at column b of each row of the first 32-row block.
+    codes[:32, :256] = torch.arange(256, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.uint8).view(1, 256)
+    codes[(codes & 0x7F) == 0x7F] -= 1
+    weight, block_scales = gemv.pack_weight(codes, scales)
+    dequantized = reference.mxfp8_weight_dequantize(codes, scales)
+    for start in range(0, k, 48):
+        columns = torch.arange(start, min(start + 48, k), device=DEVICE)
+        x = torch.zeros(columns.numel(), k, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+        x[torch.arange(columns.numel()), columns] = 1.0
+        got = gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales)
+        assert torch.equal(got.float(), dequantized[:, columns].t().float())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fp32_cublas_reduction")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 6, 24, 48])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n,k", SHAPES)
+def test_shapes(n: int, k: int, rows: int):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import gemv
+
+    codes, scales = _weight(n, k, 112, 122, seed=n + k)
+    weight, block_scales = gemv.pack_weight(codes, scales)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(rows)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, k, device=DEVICE, generator=g).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    got = gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales)
+    want = reference.mxfp8_linear(x, codes, scales)
+    dequantized = reference.mxfp8_weight_dequantize(codes, scales)
+    bound = _bound(x, dequantized, want)
+    assert ((got.double() - want).abs() <= bound).all()
+    cublas = torch.nn.functional.linear(x, dequantized)
+    assert ((got.double() - cublas.double()).abs() <= 2 * bound).all()
+    again = gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales)
+    assert torch.equal(got, again)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "config",
+    [
+        (1, 8, 1),  # 8 warps over K, 20 CTAs per row block
+        (2, 4, 4),  # 10 splits
+        (4, 2, 10),  # 8 splits, 10 blocks in flight per warp
+        (6, 1, 10),  # 16 splits, one warp per tile
+        (3, 2, 8),  # odd tiles per CTA: CTAs start mid scale block
+        (2, 8, 4),  # 16 warps, 5 splits
+    ],
+)
+def test_splits(config: tuple[int, int, int]):
+    """Every split of the columns gives the reference within the bound;
+    the counters are back at zero after each launch."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import gemv
+
+    n, k, rows = 576, 5120, 24
+    codes, scales = _weight(n, k, 112, 122, seed=3)
+    weight, block_scales = gemv.pack_weight(codes, scales)
+    x = torch.randn(rows, k, device=DEVICE).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    want = reference.mxfp8_linear(x, codes, scales)
+    bound = _bound(x, reference.mxfp8_weight_dequantize(codes, scales), want)
+    split = gemv.GemvConfig(*config)
+    for _ in range(3):
+        got = gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales, config=split)
+        assert ((got.double() - want).abs() <= bound).all()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert not gemv._counters(torch.device(DEVICE).index or 0).any()
+
+
+def test_expanded_scales_and_graph():
+    """The row-expanded scales pack to the same layout; a captured launch
+    replays on new inputs."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import gemv
+
+    n, k, rows = 1792, 5120, 6
+    codes, scales = _weight(n, k, 112, 122, seed=4)
+    weight, block_scales = gemv.pack_weight(codes, scales)
+    weight2, block_scales2 = gemv.pack_weight(
+        codes.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn), scales.repeat_interleave(32, 0)
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(weight, weight2) and torch.equal(block_scales, block_scales2)
+
+    x = torch.randn(rows, k, device=DEVICE).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    out = torch.empty(rows, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales, out=out)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales, out=out)
+    for _ in range(2):
+        x.copy_(torch.randn(rows, k, device=DEVICE))
+        out.zero_()
+        graph.replay()
+        assert torch.equal(out, gemv.mxfp8_gemv(x, weight, block_scales))

+"""The SM80 indexer's decode row split: the ranks' shares, gathered in rank
+order and cut to the step's rows, list every row once and in order, each
+share holds whole requests, and steps below the minimum stay replicated.
+Host arithmetic only."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere.indexer import (
+    ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS,
+    _decode_row_shard,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world_size", [2, 4, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("per_request", [1, 6])
+def test_shares_rebuild_the_rows(world_size: int, per_request: int) -> None:
+    for num_requests in range(1, 41):
+        rows = num_requests * per_request
+        shards = [
+            _decode_row_shard(rows, num_requests, world_size, rank)
+            for rank in range(world_size)
+        ]
+        if num_requests < ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS:
+            assert shards == [None] * world_size
+            continue
+        gathered: list[int | None] = []
+        split = [shard for shard in shards if shard is not None]

+"""The DeepSeek-V4.1 SM80 kernels against their PyTorch references.
+
+* the FP4 quantizers (indexer queries, index keys, NVFP4 compressed records)
+  and the BF16x2 FP8/FP4 decoders bitwise;
+* the indexer logits, ragged and paged, up to the FP32 summation order, the
+  paged ones split over CTAs;
+* the decode top-k and candidate-block selection exactly, ties included;
+* a candidate consumer's compact logits bitwise against the dense ones, and
+  its top-k the same keys as over the masked dense row; on SM90's FP8 cache
+  with unordered candidate blocks, the logits up to the FP32 summation order
+  and the top-k the same set;
+* sparse MLA within BF16 rounding of the probabilities, with a key list
+  split over CTAs or walked by one (several chunks per CTA), empty rows,
+  unselected (-1) entries, window-only layers, padded cache pages and head
+  counts that do not fill a CTA's 8 or 16 heads; and its V4-record variant
+  (SM90's caches) without the inverse RoPE.
+
+The kernels use SM80 instructions only, so any SM80-or-newer GPU runs them;
+about a minute, most of it compilation.

+def _paged(blocks: int, block_size: int, record: int, pad: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A zeroed uint8 cache `[blocks, block_size, record]` whose pages are
+    `pad` bytes longer than their records."""
+    raw = torch.zeros(
+        blocks, block_size * record + pad, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE
+    )
+    return raw[:, : block_size * record].view(blocks, block_size, record)

+def test_bf16x2_decoders():
+    """The pair decoders bitwise against the FP32 reference decoders rounded
+    to BF16, over every E4M3/E2M1 code and scales down to ones whose products
+    are subnormal or zero."""
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import codecs
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(words: Int64, codes: Int64, out: Int64):
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        item = Int64(block * 128 + tid)
+        word = codecs.load_u32(words + item * 4)
+        code = codecs.load_u32(codes + item * 4) & 0xFF
+        row = out + item * 24
+        ue8m0 = codecs.ue8m0_bf16x2(code)
+        e4m3 = codecs.e4m3_bf16x2(code)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            codecs.store_u32(row + 4 * i, codecs.e4m3x2_bf16(word, i, ue8m0))
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            codecs.store_u32(row + 8 + 4 * i, codecs.e2m1x2_bf16(word, i, e4m3))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def launch(words: Int64, codes: Int64, out: Int64, blocks: Int32):
+        kernel(words, codes, out).launch(grid=(blocks, 1, 1), block=[128, 1, 1])
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    # Every byte value at every position of a word; NaN E4M3 codes excluded.
+    values = torch.arange(256, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32)
+    values = values[(values & 0x7F) != 0x7F]
+    words = values[torch.randint(0, values.numel(), (128 * 64, 4), device=DEVICE)]
+    words[: values.numel(), 0] = values
+    words = words.to(torch.uint8).view(torch.int32).flatten()
+    # Codes 0..126: UE8M0 scales 2^-127..2^-1 and positive E4M3 scales (not
+    # NaN); most rows use 2^-27..2^-1.
+    codes = torch.randint(100, 127, (words.numel(),), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32)
+    codes[: values.numel() // 2] = values[: values.numel() // 2]
+    out = torch.zeros(words.numel(), 6, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    launch(
+        Int64(words.data_ptr()),
+        Int64(codes.data_ptr()),
+        Int64(out.data_ptr()),
+        Int32(words.numel() // 128),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    data = words.view(torch.uint8).view(-1, 4)
+    want_e4m3 = reference.e4m3_to_f32(data) * reference.ue8m0_to_f32(codes)[:, None]
+    nibbles = torch.stack((data & 0xF, data >> 4), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
+    want_e2m1 = (
+        reference.e2m1_to_f32(nibbles)
+        * reference.e4m3_to_f32(codes.to(torch.uint8))[:, None]
+    )
+    got = out.view(torch.int16).view(-1, 12)
+    assert torch.equal(got[:, :4], want_e4m3.bfloat16().view(torch.int16))
+    assert torch.equal(got[:, 4:], want_e2m1.bfloat16().view(torch.int16))

+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import (

+    blocks = 1200 * 64 // block_size
+    cache = _index_key_cache(blocks, block_size)
+    table = torch.randperm(blocks, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32).view(4, -1)
+    max_len = table.shape[1] * block_size
+    # Empty, below k, k, one past it, every block listed, a partial newest
+    # block, and lists of 2048 of more blocks.

+    rows = len(lens)

+    for row in range(rows):

+        if n > count:
+            older = torch.randperm(n - 1, device=DEVICE)[: count - 1]
+            chosen = torch.cat([older.sort().values, chosen[-1:]])
+        candidates[row, : chosen.numel()] = chosen.int()
+    got, compact_lens = mqa_logits.candidate_mqa_logits(
+        q_values, q_scales, cache, weights, lens, table, 1, candidates, block, splits
+    )

+    )

+        keys = (listed[:, None] * block + torch.arange(block, device=DEVICE)).flatten()
+        assert int(compact_lens[row]) == keys.numel()
+        valid = keys < n

+def _fp8_index_key_cache(blocks: int, block_size: int):
+    """A paged SM90 FP8 index key cache (each page's E4M3 keys, then their
+    FP32 scales) and its keys decoded, `[blocks * block_size, 128]`."""
+    cache = _paged(blocks, block_size, 132, 32)
+    keys = torch.randn(blocks, block_size, 128, device=DEVICE)
+    scales = keys.abs().amax(-1) / 448
+    values = (keys / scales[..., None]).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    page = cache.view(blocks, block_size * 132)
+    page[:, : block_size * 128] = values.view(torch.uint8).view(blocks, -1)
+    page[:, block_size * 128 :] = scales.view(torch.uint8)
+    return cache, (values.float() * scales[..., None]).view(-1, 128)

+        assert torch.equal(got, want.sort(-1).values)
+        del logits

+
+def _fill_window_cache(cache: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Random MXFP8 window records, some values E4M3 subnormals."""
+    tokens = cache.shape[0] * cache.shape[1]
+    x = torch.randn(tokens, 512, device=DEVICE) * 2
+    x[:, :8] *= 1e-3
+    blocks = x.unflatten(-1, (16, 32))
+    amax = blocks.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-30)
+    exponent = torch.ceil(torch.log2(amax / 448)).clamp(-127, 127)
+    values = (blocks / torch.exp2(exponent)[..., None]).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)

+        [values.view(torch.uint8).flatten(-2), (exponent + 127).to(torch.uint8)], -1
+    )

+

+        latents, index, cos_sin, 1
+    )

+    swa_indices = torch.randint(
+        0, 40 * 32, (tokens, window), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    swa_lens = torch.randint(
+        0 if empty else window // 2,
+        window + 1,

+        device=DEVICE,
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+    )
+    compressed_indices = torch.randint(
+        0, 20 * 64, (tokens, top_k), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    compressed_lens = torch.randint(
+        0, top_k + 1, (tokens,), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    if empty:
+        swa_lens[0] = 0
+        compressed_lens[0] = 0
+    # Unselected entries inside a row's length are -1 and skipped.
+    compressed_indices[:, 7::50] = -1
+    sink = torch.randn(heads, device=DEVICE)
+    positions = torch.randint(0, 4096, (tokens,), device=DEVICE)
+    args = (
+        q,
+        swa,
+        swa_indices,
+        swa_lens,
+        None if window_only else compressed,
+        None if window_only else compressed_indices,
+        None if window_only else compressed_lens,
+        sink,
+        512**-0.5,
+        positions,
+        cos_sin,

+
+
+def _v4_cache(blocks: int, block_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A V4-record cache of random keys, each 64-dim block at its own power
+    of two (so every scale byte matters; some values E4M3 subnormals), its
+    pages padded to a multiple of 576 bytes as vLLM allocates them."""
+    cache = _paged(blocks, block_size, 584, -(block_size * 584) % 576)
+    x = torch.randn(blocks * block_size, 8, 64, device=DEVICE)
+    x *= torch.exp2(torch.randint(-3, 4, (len(x), 8, 1), device=DEVICE))
+    x = x.flatten(1)
+    x[:, :8] *= 1e-3
+    reference.store_v4_records(cache, torch.arange(len(x), device=DEVICE), x)

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The SM80 mHC boundary kernels against their PyTorch references and the
+stock TileLang kernels.
+
+Error bounds:
+
+* the post-mixed streams and the layer input: one BF16 ulp (relative 2^-7)
+  plus an absolute FP32-accumulation term, which matters only where the
+  post-mix or the collapse cancels;
+* the stream mean: bitwise the BF16 mean of the kernel's own streams (the
+  FP32 sum of four BF16 values is exact at these magnitudes); against
+  the reference, one BF16 ulp of the mean plus the mean of the streams'
+  differences (a stream one ulp off near a rounding tie shifts the mean by a
+  quarter of that ulp, which cancellation in the mean does not scale down);
+* the coefficients: 4e-6 absolute against the reference evaluated on the
+  kernel's own streams (FP32 sums of up to 20480 products, in another
+  order) and, for the four streams on SM80, with the projection rounded to
+  the two BF16 terms the tensor-core kernel multiplies by;
+* against the stock kernels: the streams and layer input as above, and the
+  coefficients within twice the effect of rounding the projection input to
+  BF16 -- the stock fused kernel of up to 32 rows projects the unrounded
+  FP32 streams, these kernels (like the stock path above 32 rows and the
+  PyTorch reference) the stored BF16 streams -- plus the effect of the
+  two-term projection.
+
+Also covered: the ticket counters across repeated launches and the
+side-stream boundary inside a CUDA graph.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from . import reference
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda() or not current_platform.has_device_capability(80),
+    reason="needs an SM80-or-newer CUDA GPU",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+HIDDEN = 5120
+EPS = 1e-20
+SINKHORN = (1e-6, 1e-6, 2.0, 20)
+
+
+def _inputs(rows: int, seed: int = 0) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A boundary's operands at DeepSeek-V4.1 scale."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def randn(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.rand(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+
+    return {
+        "x": randn(rows, HIDDEN).bfloat16(),
+        "residual": (randn(rows, 4, HIDDEN) * 2).bfloat16(),
+        "post": rand(rows, 4) * 2,
+        "comb": torch.softmax(randn(rows, 4, 4), -1),
+        "pre": rand(rows, 4) + 1e-6,
+        "weight": (rand(HIDDEN) + 0.5).bfloat16(),
+        "fn": randn(24, 4 * HIDDEN) * 0.02,
+        "scale": rand(3) + 0.5,
+        "base": randn(24) * 0.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _projection_terms(fn: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The projection as the tensor-core kernel multiplies by it: each FP32
+    weight as the sum of `hi = bf16(w)` and `lo = bf16(w - hi)`."""
+    hi = fn.bfloat16().float()
+    return hi + (fn - hi).bfloat16().float()
+
+
+def _assert_bf16_close(got: torch.Tensor, want: torch.Tensor, atol: float):
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got.float(), want.float(), rtol=2**-7, atol=atol)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 6, 48, 192])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["post", "post_aux", "collapse", "first"])
+def test_post_collapse(rows, mode):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import mhc
+
+    t = _inputs(rows)
+    if mode.startswith("post"):
+        args = (t["x"], t["residual"], t["post"], t["comb"], t["pre"])
+    else:
+        args = (
+            None,
+            t["residual"],
+            None,
+            None,
+            t["pre"] if mode == "collapse" else None,
+        )
+    aux = mode == "post_aux"
+    got = mhc.mhc_post_collapse(*args, t["weight"], EPS, aux)
+    want = reference.mhc_post_collapse(*args, t["weight"], EPS, aux)
+    _assert_bf16_close(got[0], want[0], 1e-4)
+    _assert_bf16_close(got[1], want[1], 2e-3)
+    assert got[2].shape == want[2].shape
+    if aux:
+        assert torch.equal(got[2], got[0].double().mean(1).bfloat16())
+        mean, want_mean = got[2].double(), want[2].double()
+        stream_error = (got[0].double() - want[0].double()).abs().mean(1)
+        bound = stream_error + torch.maximum(mean.abs(), want_mean.abs()) * 2**-7
+        assert ((mean - want_mean).abs() <= bound + 1e-6).all()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 6, 17, 48, 192])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["post", "streams", "broadcast"])
+def test_coefficients(rows, mode):
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import mhc
+
+    t = _inputs(rows)
+    fn = t["fn"]
+    if mode == "post":
+        args = (t["x"], t["residual"], t["post"], t["comb"])
+        streams = mhc.mhc_post_collapse(*args, t["pre"], t["weight"], EPS)[0]
+    elif mode == "streams":
+        args = (None, t["residual"], None, None)
+        streams = t["residual"]
+    else:
+        args = (None, t["x"], None, None)
+        streams = t["x"]
+        fn = fn[:, :HIDDEN].contiguous()
+    tail = (fn, t["scale"], t["base"], EPS, *SINKHORN)
+    got = mhc.mhc_coefficients(*args, *tail)
+    # SM80's tensor-core kernel (four streams) multiplies by the two terms.
+    mma = mode != "broadcast" and mhc._uses_mma(mhc.HC, HIDDEN)
+    terms = _projection_terms(fn) if mma else fn
+    want = reference.mhc_coefficients(None, streams, None, None, terms, *tail[1:])
+    for g, w in zip(got, want):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(g, w, rtol=0, atol=4e-6)
+    # The last CTA resets its ticket counter, so launches repeat bitwise.
+    for _ in range(3):
+        again = mhc.mhc_coefficients(*args, *tail)
+        for g, a in zip(got, again):
+            assert torch.equal(g, a)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [6, 48])
+def test_boundary_in_cuda_graph(rows):
+    """The boundary with its coefficients on a side stream, eagerly and
+    captured and replayed, equals the single-stream boundary."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import mhc
+
+    t = _inputs(rows)
+    args = (
+        t["x"],
+        t["residual"],
+        t["post"].unsqueeze(-1),
+        t["comb"],
+        t["fn"],
+        t["scale"],
+        t["base"],
+        EPS,
+        *SINKHORN,
+        t["pre"],
+        t["weight"],
+        EPS,
+        True,
+    )
+    want = mhc.mhc_post_pre(*args)
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    capture = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    # Launches of the coefficients share the ticket counters, so the side
+    # stream starts after the boundary above, as the model's boundaries do.
+    capture.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(capture):
+        warm = mhc.mhc_post_pre(*args, stream=side)
+        capture.wait_stream(side)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=capture):
+            got = mhc.mhc_post_pre(*args, stream=side)
+            capture.wait_stream(side)
+    for g, w in zip(warm, want):
+        assert torch.equal(g, w)
+    for _ in range(2):
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        for g, w in zip(got, want):
+            assert torch.equal(g, w)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [6, 48])
+def test_matches_stock_kernels(rows):
+    tilelang = pytest.importorskip("vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang")
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere import mhc
+
+    t = _inputs(rows)
+    args = (
+        t["x"],
+        t["residual"],
+        t["post"].unsqueeze(-1),
+        t["comb"],
+        t["fn"],
+        t["scale"],
+        t["base"],
+        EPS,
+        *SINKHORN,
+    )
+    stock = tilelang.mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_tilelang(
+        *args, pre_mix=t["pre"], norm_weight=t["weight"], norm_eps=EPS
+    )
+    ours = mhc.mhc_post_pre(*args, t["pre"], t["weight"], EPS)
+    _assert_bf16_close(ours[0], stock[0], 1e-4)
+    _assert_bf16_close(ours[3], stock[3], 2e-3)
+
+    # The effect of rounding the projection input to BF16.
+    tail = (t["fn"], t["scale"], t["base"], EPS, *SINKHORN)
+    rounded = reference.mhc_post(t["x"], t["residual"], t["post"], t["comb"])
+    exact = torch.einsum("nkj,nkh->njh", t["comb"].double(), t["residual"].double())
+    exact = exact + t["post"].double()[:, :, None] * t["x"].double()[:, None, :]
+    from_rounded = reference.mhc_coefficients(None, rounded, None, None, *tail)
+    from_exact = reference.mhc_coefficients(None, exact, None, None, *tail)
+    from_terms = reference.mhc_coefficients(
+        None, rounded, None, None, _projection_terms(t["fn"]), *tail[1:]
+    )
+    # Post-, comb- and pre-mix, in the reference's order.
+    for i, index in enumerate((1, 2, 4)):
+        bound = (
+            2 * (from_rounded[i] - from_exact[i]).abs().max().item()
+            + (from_terms[i] - from_rounded[i]).abs().max().item()
+            + 1e-5
+        )
+        error = (ours[index].view(rows, -1) - stock[index].view(rows, -1)).abs()
+        assert error.max().item() <= bound

+"""The SM80 split-k mHC projection of prefill boundaries against an FP64

+  `hi + lo` split keeps 16 bits of each weight; the FP32 sums of up to
+  1280 products add a few ulp);
+* a partial sum of squares: 1e-5 relative (exact squares, FP32 sums);
+* the coefficients: 2e-5 absolute against the reference evaluated on the
+  same streams; the layer input and the stream mean: one BF16 ulp of the
+  stock path's, whose epilogue they share.
+"""
+

+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from . import reference
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(

+)

+

+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere.mhc_projection import (  # noqa: E501
+        SPLITS,
+        mhc_projection,
+    )
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(rows)
+    x = (torch.randn(rows, width, device=DEVICE, generator=g) * 2).bfloat16()
+    fn = torch.randn(24, width, device=DEVICE, generator=g) * 0.02
+    mixes, sqrsum = mhc_projection(x, fn)
+    xs = x.double().view(rows, SPLITS, -1)
+    ws = fn.double().view(24, SPLITS, -1)
+    want = torch.einsum("nsk,jsk->snj", xs, ws)
+    scale = torch.einsum("nsk,jsk->snj", xs.abs(), ws.abs())
+    assert ((mixes.double() - want).abs() <= scale * 2**-14).all()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        sqrsum.double(), xs.square().sum(-1).T, rtol=1e-5, atol=0
+    )

+        "fn": randn(24, 4 * HIDDEN) * 0.02,
+        "scale": rand(3) + 0.5,
+        "base": randn(24) * 0.5,

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [300, 2048])

+"""The SM80/SM90 indexer's prefill row split: the ranks' balanced shares
+cover every row, and each rank's narrowed chunks score exactly its share,
+with the matching key bounds, while a chunk holding none of its rows keeps
+an empty window (it still gathers the keys a continuation chunk reuses).
+Host arithmetic only."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.ampere.row_shard import (
+    PrefillRowShard,
+    RowShardedPrefillMetadata,
+    balanced_prefill_row_shard,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata,
+)
+
+
+def _chunk(start: int, end: int, skip_kv_gather: bool):
+    rows = torch.arange(start, end)
+    return DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata(
+        block_table=torch.zeros(1, 1, dtype=torch.int32),
+        cu_seqlen_ks=rows * 10,
+        cu_seqlen_ke=rows * 10 + 7,
+        cu_seq_lens=torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.int32),
+        token_to_seq=torch.zeros(end - start, dtype=torch.int32),
+        total_seq_lens=0,
+        max_seqlen_k=0,
+        token_start=start,
+        token_end=end,
+        num_reqs=1,
+        skip_kv_gather=skip_kv_gather,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world_size", [2, 4, 8])
+def test_shares_cover_the_rows(world_size: int) -> None:
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([98304, 512, 8192])
+    query_lens = torch.tensor([4096, 512, 1000])
+    sizes = balanced_prefill_row_shard(seq_lens, query_lens, 4, world_size)
+    assert sizes is not None and len(sizes) == world_size
+    assert sum(sizes) == int(query_lens.sum()) and min(sizes) > 0
+    # Fewer rows than ranks stay replicated.
+    few = torch.tensor([3])
+    assert balanced_prefill_row_shard(seq_lens[:1], few, 4, 8) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world_size", [2, 4, 8])
+def test_narrowed_chunks_score_each_share(world_size: int) -> None:
+    num_decode_tokens = 12
+    # One request's 900 rows in a first chunk and two continuation chunks,
+    # then a second request's 100 rows.
+    bounds = [(12, 412, False), (412, 812, True), (812, 912, True), (912, 1012, False)]
+    prefill = RowShardedPrefillMetadata(
+        [_chunk(*b) for b in bounds],
+        row_shard_sizes=[1000 // world_size] * (world_size - 1)
+        + [1000 - (world_size - 1) * (1000 // world_size)],
+    )
+    covered: list[int] = []
+    for rank in range(world_size):
+        shard = PrefillRowShard(num_decode_tokens, prefill.row_shard_sizes, rank)
+        narrowed = shard.narrow_prefill(prefill)
+        assert len(narrowed.chunks) == len(prefill.chunks)
+        for chunk, full in zip(narrowed.chunks, prefill.chunks):
+            assert chunk.skip_kv_gather == full.skip_kv_gather
+            assert full.token_start <= chunk.token_start <= chunk.token_end
+            assert chunk.token_end <= full.token_end
+            rows = torch.arange(chunk.token_start, chunk.token_end)
+            assert torch.equal(chunk.cu_seqlen_ks, rows * 10)
+            assert torch.equal(chunk.cu_seqlen_ke, rows * 10 + 7)
+            if chunk.token_end > chunk.token_start:
+                assert shard.start <= chunk.token_start
+                assert chunk.token_end <= shard.stop
+            covered += rows.tolist()
+    assert covered == list(range(num_decode_tokens, num_decode_tokens + 1000))

+"""The SM90 candidate source's block selection: on SM90 the specialized
+decode's `select_candidate_blocks_cooperative` selects the same candidate
+set as vLLM's `select_candidate_blocks` (`torch.topk` over the whole
+width), eagerly and replayed from a CUDA graph, at the source's decode shapes
+(rows of 2048 blocks of 8 positions in logits as wide as a 1M-token model's
+262,144 compressed positions) and around the cooperative kernel's limits."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda() or not current_platform.is_device_capability(90),
+    reason="needs an SM90 GPU",
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+BLOCK = 8
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("ends", "k", "width"),
+    [
+        # Six and 24 decode rows of one request each at the source's shape.
+        ((2048 * 8 - 5, 9000, 65536, 131072, 262144, 1), 2048, 262144),
+        (tuple(range(1, 262145, 262144 // 24))[:24], 2048, 262144),
+        # Rows around the 16384-block register-path limit.
+        (
+            (16384 * 8, 16384 * 8 - 3, 16385 * 8 + 1, 3000 * 8 + 5, 20000 * 8),
+            2048,
+            1 << 20,
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_cooperative_candidates_match_stock(workspace_init, ends, k, width):
+    """Each row's candidate set equals the stock selection, including the
+    pinned newest block and -inf blocks left as -1."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.candidate_blocks import (
+        select_candidate_blocks,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.attention.candidate_topk import (  # noqa: E501
+        select_candidate_blocks_cooperative,
+    )
+
+    rows = len(ends)
+    logits = torch.empty(rows, width, device=DEVICE)
+    row_ends = torch.tensor(ends, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+
+    def fill_logits(seed):
+        torch.manual_seed(seed)
+        logits.normal_()
+        logits[0, : 50 * BLOCK] = float("-inf")
+        end = ends[-1]
+        logits[-1, (end - 1) // BLOCK * BLOCK : end] = -100.0  # lowest, but pinned
+
+    def select(selector):
+        # In-range stale ids: a slot the selection skips would leak one.
+        out = torch.full((rows, k), 7, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+        selector(out)
+        return out
+
+    def stock():
+        return select(
+            lambda out: select_candidate_blocks(logits, None, row_ends, k, BLOCK, out)
+        )
+
+    def cooperative():
+        return select(
+            lambda out: select_candidate_blocks_cooperative(
+                logits, row_ends, BLOCK, out
+            )
+        )
+
+    def assert_same_sets(got, want):
+        assert torch.equal(got.sort(dim=1).values, want.sort(dim=1).values)
+
+    fill_logits(0)
+    assert_same_sets(cooperative(), stock())
+    cooperative()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        out = cooperative()
+    fill_logits(1)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert_same_sets(out, stock())
